Mitzvat terumat maaser sheyyafrish otan ben levi mimmaasro. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 26)</small> "vechi tikchu meet bene yisrael et hammaaser". veyesh leyisrael lehaferish otah velittenah lakkohen. veyitten hammaaser lallevi achar sheyyafrish mimmennu terumato shehi maaser min hammaaser:

Yisrael shehifrish maaser rishon keshehu shibbolim kodem sheyyadush veyafrish teruma gedola unetano lelevi. en hallevi chayyav lehaferish mimmennu teruma gedola achar sheyyedushennu ella terumat maaser bilvad. aval im dash yisrael vehifrish hammaaser min haddagan kodem sheyyafrish teruma gedola [unetano lelevi chayyav hallevi lehaferish mimmennu teruma gedola] uterumat maaser meachar shennaasa dagan nitchayyev bitruma shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "reshit degancha":

Ben levi shellakach maasar shibbolim lo yitten terumato lakkohen shibbolim ella konsin oto ladush velizrot velitten lo maaser min hammaaser min haddagan. veeno chayyav litten lo maaser min hatteven o haetza. veim hifrish terumat maaser shibbolim kemo shennatnu lo hare ze kotesh venoten lakkohen et hazzera veet hatteven. umippene ma kenasuhu lichtosh mippene shellakach hammaaser shibbolim vehifkia mimmennu teruma gedola:

Ben yisrael sheamar lelevi kach amar li abba maaser lecha beyadi en choshshin litrumat maaser shebbo. shehare aviv hifrish terumato ulefichach tzivvahu shezze hammaaser lifloni hallevi. veim amar lo kach amar li abba kor maaser yesh lecha beyadi choshshin litrumat maaser shebbo:

Terumat maaser shehaya bah echad mishshemona bishminit molichah lakkohen. pachot mikken eno metappel leholichah ella mashlichah baur vesorfah. uveyayin uveshemen afillu kol shehu molichah lakkohen. uvilvad shettehe terumat maaser vaddait utehora. aval im hayta temea o shehayta shel demay im en bah kashshiur eno metappel bah ella sorfah:

En tormin teruma gedola ella min hammukkaf. ketzad. hayu lo chamishshim sea bevayit ze vachamishshim sea bevayit acher lo yafrish meechad mehen shete seim al hammea. shennimtza mafrish mimmakom ze al makom acher. veim hifrish shello min hammukkaf terumato teruma vehu sheyyihye hammufrash shamur aval im haya taun kadde yayin o shemen veraa shemmishtabberin veamar hare hen teruma al perot shebbeveti lo amar kelum:

Perot hamefuzzarin betoch habbayit o shete megurot shebbevayit echad torem meechad al hakkol. sakke tevua veiggule devela vechaviyyot shel gerogarot im hayu bahakefa achat torem meachat al hakkol. chaviyyot shel yayin ad shello satam et pihen torem meechad al hakkol. mishshessatam torem mikkol achat veachat:

Haya melakket gappe yarak umanniach bagginna torem meechad al hakkol. hevi min echad benehen torem mikkol echad veechad. hevi minin harebe bakkuppa keruv millemala ucheruv millematta umin acher baemtza lo yitrom min haelyon al hattachton. veim hikkif chamishsha tzibburim begoren torem meechad al hakkol bizman sheikkar haggoren kayyam. en ikkar haggoren kayyam torem mikkol echad veechad:

Terumat maaser mafrishin oto shello min hammukkaf shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 28 29)</small> "mikkol maserotechem tarimu teruma" afillu maaser echad bimdina zo umaaser echad bimdina acheret mafrish teruma meechad al hakkol. vetalmide chachamim en tormin ella min hammukkaf vaafillu terumat maaser:

Ben levi shehaya lo maaser rishon shello nittela mimmennu terumato vehinnicho lihyot mafrish alav veholech vehu betivlo ma sheasa asuy. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 24)</small> "ki et masar bene yisrael asher yarimu laAdonai teruma" melammed shehu ose et kullo teruma leacher:

Hifrish mimmennu terumat maaser techilla veachar kach hinnicho lihyot mafrish alav veholech ad sheyyaase kullo terumat maaser veyitteno lakkohen lo asa kelum. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 29)</small> "et mikdesho mimmennu" bizman shekkadashav betocho ose oto teruma laacherim. en kadashav betocho eno ose oto teruma laacherim. vechen hammanniach perot lihyot mafrish alehem teruma gedola tzarich sheyyihyu tevulin litruma. veim hinnichan lihyot mafrish alehen maaser tzarich sheyyihyu tevulin lemaaser:

Keshemmafrishin teruma umaaser mafrishin otan al hasseder. ketzad. mafrish bikkurim techilla lakkol. veachar kach teruma gedola. veachar kach maaser rishon. veachar kach maaser sheni o maaser ani. vehammakdim sheni larishon. o maaser litruma. o teruma levikkurim. af al pi sheavar al lo taase ma sheasa asuy. uminnayin shehu belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 28)</small> "meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher". lo teacher davar sherauy lehakedimo. veen lokin al lav ze:

Harotze lehaferish teruma gedola uterumat maaser keechad mafrish echad mishsheloshim ushelosha ushelish. veomer echad mimmea sheyyesh kan hare hu betzad ze shehifrashti vahare hu chullin. vehannishar mizze shehifrashti hu teruma al hakkol. vehammaaser sherauy lihyot lemea chullin ellu hare hu betzad ze shehifrashti. veze hannishar yeter al hatteruma mimma shehifrashti hare hu terumat maaser al hakkol:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 4:
Ose adam shaliach lehaferish lo terumot umaasrot shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 28)</small> "ken tarimu gam attem" lerabbot sheluchachem. veen osin shaliach akkum shenneemar gam attem ma attem bene berit af sheluchachem bene berit: 
Chamishsha lo yitromu veim tarmu en terumatan teruma. hacheresh. vehashshote. vehakkatan. vehaakkum shettaram et shel yisrael vaafillu birshuto. vehattorem et sheeno shello shello birshut habbealim. aval hattorem mishshello al shel acherim hare zo teruma vetikken perotehem. vetovat hanaa shello shennotnah lechol kohen sheyyirtze: 
Hattorem shello birshut o sheyyarad letoch sede chavero velikket perot shello birshut kede sheyyikkachem vetaram. im ba baal habbayit veamar lo kallech etzel yafot. im hayu sham yafot mimma shettaram terumato teruma shehare eno makpid. veim lo hayu sham yafot en terumato teruma shello amar lo ella al derech michuy. veim ba baal habbayit velikket vehosif ben yesh lo yafot mehen ben en lo terumato teruma: 
Chamishsha lo yitromu veim tarmu terumatan teruma. cheresh medabber veeno shomea mippene sheeno shomea habberacha. vehaillem sheshshomea veeno medabber. vehearum. mippene sheenan yecholin levarech. vehashshikkor vehassuma mippene sheenan yecholin lechavven ulehafrish et hayyafe: 
Katan shehiggia leonat nedarim af al pi shello hevi shete searot velo naasa gadol im taram terumato teruma. vaafillu bitruma shel tora hoil venidrehen vehekdeshan kayyamin min hattora kemo shebbearnu bindarim: 
Haomer lishlucho tze uterom li vehalach litrom veeno yodea im taram veim lo taram uva umatza keri tarum en chezkato tarum. sheen omrin beissurin chezkat shaliach ose shelichuto lehakel ella lehachamir vechoshesh shemma acher taram shello birshut: 
Haomer lishlucho tze uterom torem kedato shel baal habbayit. im haya yodea bo shehu baal ayin raa mafrish echad mishshishshim. veim haya baal nefesh sevea mafrish echad mearbaim. veim eno yodea dato mafrish lo benonit echad mechamishshim. nitkavven levenonit vealta beyado echad mearbaim o echad mishshishshim terumato teruma. veim nitkavven lehosif al habbenonit vetaram afillu echad mittishim vetisha en terumato teruma: 
Perot hashshuttafin chayyavot bitruma umaasrot shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 28)</small> "maserotechem" afillu shel shenayim. vehashshuttafin enan tzerichin littol reshut ze mizze. ella kol hattorem mehen terumato teruma. taram echad mehen uva hashsheni vetaram teruma sheniyya shehare lo yada shechavero taram. im hayu memachin ze al ze terumat hashsheni enah teruma. veim lo hayu memachin vetaram harishon kashshiur (en terumat hashsheni teruma lo taram harishon kashshiur) terumat shenehen teruma: 
Haomer leshuttafo o leven beto o leavdo o leshifchato litrom. vehalchu litrom uvittel shelichuto kodem sheyyitromu. im lo shinna hashshaliach terumato teruma. veim shinna kegon sheamar lo terom min hatztzafon vetaram min haddarom hoil uvittel shelichuto mikkodem enah teruma: 
Aris shettaram uva baal habbayit veikkev im ad shello taram ikkev en terumato teruma veim mishshettaram ikkev terumato teruma. vehaappotroppesin tormin minnichse yetomim: 
Haggannav vehaggazlan vehaannas terumatan teruma. veim hayu habbealim rodfin acharehen en terumatan teruma: 
Habben vehassachir vehaeved vehaishsha tormin al ma shehen ochlin. aval lo yitremu al hakkol sheen adam torem davar sheeno shello. habben kesheochel im aviv vehaishsha beissatah tormin mippene shehen birshut: 
Happoalim en lahen reshut litrom shello middaat baal habbayit. chutz min haddorchin begat sheim yirtzu letamme et hayyayin hare hen metammeim miyyad. ulefi shemmasar lahen veheeminan al ken hare hen kishluchin veim tarmu terumatan teruma: 
Poel sheamar lo baal habbayit kenos li garni uterom vetaram veachar kach kanas terumato teruma: 
Haakkum shehifrish teruma mishshello din tora sheenah teruma lefi sheenan chayyavin. umiddivrehen gazru shettihye terumato teruma mishshum baale kisin. shello yihye ze hammamon shel yisrael veyitle oto beakkum kede lefatro. uvodkin et haakkum shehifrish teruma im amar bedaat yisrael hifrashtiha tinnaten lechohen. veim lav teuna geniza shemma belibbo lashshamayim. bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael. aval akkum shehifrish teruma bechutza laaretz lo gazru alehen umodiin oto sheeno tzarich veenah teruma kelal: 
Hammitkavven lomar teruma veamar maaser. maaser veamar teruma. lo amar kelum. ad sheyyihye piv velibbo shavin. hifrish teruma bemachashavto velo hotzi bisfatav kelum hare zo teruma shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 27)</small> "venechshav lachem terumatchem kaddagan min haggoren" bemachashava bilvad tihye teruma: 
Hammafrish teruma al tenay im nitkayyem hattenay hare hi teruma. veim lav enah teruma. vechen hammafrish teruma umaasrot venicham alehen hare ze nishal lechacham umattir lo kederech shemmattirin lo shear nedarim. vetachazor chullin kemo shehayta ad sheyyafrish paam sheniyya otah shehifrish techilla o perot acherot: 
Hattorem bor shel yayin veamar hare zo teruma al menat shettaale shalem [tzarich shettaale] shalem min hashshever umin hashsheficha aval lo min hattuma. veim nishbera enah medammaat. hinnichah bemakom sheim tishshaver sham o titgalgel lo taggia labbor hare zo medammaat shekkevar nitkayyem hattenay: 
Bamme devarim amurim bitruma gedola. aval bitrumat maaser shemmuttar litrom shello min hammukkaf kevan shealta nitkayyem tenao vahare hi terumat maaser veaf al pi shennishbera o shennishpecha veen tzarich lomar shennitmet: 
Haomer shellemala teruma veshellematta chullin o shellemala chullin veshellematta teruma devarav kayyamin shehaddavar taluy bedaat hattorem: 
Hattorem et haggoren tzarich sheyyechavven et libbo shettihye zo teruma al hakkeri veal ma shebbakkutein veal ma shebbatztzedadin veal ma shebbetoch hatteven. hattorem et hayyekev tzarich sheyyechavvin et libbo litrom al ma shebbachartzannin veal ma shebbazzaggin. hattorem et habbor shel yayin tzarich sheyyechavven et libbo litrom al ma shebbaggefet. veim lo nitkavven ella taram setam niftar hakkol. shettenay bet din hu shehatteruma al hakkol. hattorem kalkala shel teenim venimtzeu teenim betzad hakkalkala hare ellu peturin mippene shebbelibbo litrom al hakkol:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 5:
En tormin ella min hayyafe shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 30)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 18 32)</small> "baharimchem et chelbo mimmennu". veim en sham kohen torem min hammitkayyem af al pi sheyyesh sham yafe sheeno mitkayyem. ketzad. torem teenim al haggerogarot. uvemakom sheen sham kohen torem gerogarot al hatteenim. veim ragil laasot teenim gerogarot torem min hatteenim al haggerogarot afillu bemakom sheen sham kohen. aval bemakom sheyyesh bo kohen en tormin min haggerogarot al hatteenim afillu lemakom sheddarkan laasot teenim gerogarot: 
Tormin batzal shalem af al pi shehu katan. aval lo chatzi batzal af al pi shehu gadol. bechol makom en tormin mimmin al sheeno mino shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 27)</small> "kaddagan min haggoren vechamlea min hayyekev". veim taram en terumato teruma: 
Hakkeshut vehammelaffon min echad. kol min chittim echad. kol min teenim ugerogarot udevela echad. vetorem mizze al ze. vechol shehu kilayim bachavero lo yitrom mizze al ze afillu min hayyafe al hara. ketzad. hayu lo chamishshim sea chittin vachamishshim sea seorim bevayit echad vehifrish al hakkol shene sein chittin enan teruma. vechol sheeno kilayim bachavero torem min hayyafe al hara aval lo min hara al hayyafe. veim taram terumato teruma chutz min hazzonin al hachittim mippene sheenan ochel adam: 
En tormin middavar shennigmera melachto al davar shello nigmera melachto. velo middavar shello nigmera melachto al davar shello nigmera melachto. velo middavar shello nigmera melachto al davar shennigmera melachto. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 27)</small> "kaddagan min haggoren vechamlea min hayyekev" min haggamur al haggamur. veim tarmu terumatan teruma: 
Meematay tormin et haggoren mishsheyyivror. barar miktzat tormin min habbarur al sheeno barur. hammachnis shibbolim letoch beto laasotan melilot hare ze torem min shibbolim: 
Meematay tormin et haggat mishsheyyehallechu bah sheti vaerev. meematay tormin et hazzetim mishsheyyitanu: 
En tormin min hattahor al hattame veim taram terumato teruma. vahalacha lemoshe missinay sheiggul shel devela shennitma miktzato tormin lechattechilla min hattahor shebbo al hattame shebbo. velo haiggul bilvad shehu guf echad ella afillu agudda shel yarak afillu aremot shel chittim shennitmea miktzatah tormin min hattahor shebbah al hattame shebbah. aval im hayu shene iggulim o shete aguddot o shete aremot achat temea veachat tehora betziddah lo yitrom min hattahor al hattame lechattechilla. vetormin terumat maaser min hattahor al hattame lechattechilla shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 29)</small> "et mikdasho mimmennu" tol min hamekuddash shebbo: 
En tormin min hattame al hattahor veim taram beshogeg terumato teruma. bemezid lo tikken et hashsheyarim veze sheherim teruma veyachazor veyitrom. bamme devarim amurim shello yada battuma. aval im yada veshagag shemmuttar litrom min hattame al hattahor hare hu kemezid. vechen bitrumat maaser: 
En tormin min hamechubbar al hattalush velo min hattalush al hamechubbar. ketzad. hayu lo perot telushin veamar perot ellu yihyu teruma al perot ellu hamechubbarim afillu (amar) lichsheyyittalshu. o shehayu lo shete arugot veamar perot aruga zo telushin yihyu teruma al perot aruga zo mechubbarim. o sheamar perot aruga zo mechubbarim yihyu teruma al perot aruga zo telushin lo amar kelum. aval im amar perot aruga zo telushin yihyu teruma al perot aruga zo lichsheyyittalshu venitleshu hoil uveyado letalshan eno mechussar maase velichsheyyittalshu shenehem devarav kayyamin. vehu sheyyaviu shetehen shelish beet sheamar: 
En tormin min hallach al hayyavesh velo min hayyavesh al hallach. veim taram terumato teruma. ketzad. likket yarak hayyom velikket mimmennu lemachar en tormin mizze al ze ella im ken darko lehishtammer shene yamim. vechen yarak sheddarko lehishtammer shelosha yamim kegon hammelaffonot kol shellikket bishloshet yamim mitztaref vetorem mizze al ze. yarak sheddarko lehishtammer yom echad bilvad velikket beshacharit velikket baerev torem mizze al ze: 
En tormin mipperot shana zo al perot shana sheavra. velo mipperot shana sheavra al perot shana zo. veim taram enah teruma shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 22)</small> "shana shana". likket yarak erev rosh hashshana ad shello baa hashshemesh vechazar velikket achar shebbaa hashshemesh en tormin mizze al ze shezze chadash veze yashan. vechen im likket etrog beerev 15 bishvat ad shello ba hashshemesh vechazar velikket etrog acher mishshebbaa hashshemesh en tormin mizze al ze mippene sheechad betishre rosh hashshana lemaasrot tevua vekitniyyot virakot. vetv bishvat rosh hashshana lemaasrot hailan: 
En tormin perot haaretz al perot chutza laaretz. velo mipperot chutza laaretz al perot haaretz. [velo mipperot haaretz al perot sureya. velo mipperot sureya al perot haaretz]. velo mipperot sheenan chayyavin bitruma kegon leket shichcha ufea. o perot shennitrema terumatan al perot shechayyavin bitruma. velo mipperot shechayyavin bitruma al perot happeturin. veim taram enah teruma: 
Hammafrish teruma mimmaaser rishon shello nittela terumato. o mimmaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu al perot acherot en terumatan teruma: 
En tormin middavar shehu chayyav min hattora al davar shehu chayyav middivrehen velo min hamechuyyav middivrehen al hachayyav min hattora. veim taram terumato teruma veyachazor veyitrom: 
Atzitz nakuv hare hu keeretz. vechamma yehe bannekev kede shoresh katan vehu pachot mikkezayit. zara tevua beatzitz sheeno nakuv vehevia shelish veachar kach nikkevo venigmera hattevua vehu nakuv hare hu katztzomeach besheeno nakuv ad sheyyikkevennu kodem sheyyavi shelish: 
Hattorem mipperot haggedelin beeretz al haggedelin beatzitz nakuv o mipperot atzitz nakuv al haggedelin baaretz terumato teruma. taram mishsheeno nakuv al hannakuv terumato teruma veyachazor veyitrom. taram min hannakuv al sheeno nakuv terumato teruma velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha teruma umaasrot mimmakom acher: 
Hattorem min haddemay al haddemay umin haddemay al havvadday terumato teruma veyachazor veyitrom mikkol echad veechad bifne atzmo. taram min havvadday al haddemay terumato teruma velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha teruma umaasrot: 
En tormin shibbolim al hachittim. vezetim al shemen. vaanavim al yayin. veim taram enah teruma gezera shemma yatriach hakkohen lidroch velichtosh. aval tormin shemen al hazzetim hannichbashin veyayin al anavim laasotan tzimmukin. lema ze dome letorem mishshene minin sheenan kilayim ze baze min hayyafe al hara. vechen tormin mizzete shemen al zete kevesh. aval lo mizzete kevesh al zete shemen. miyyayin sheeno mevushshal al hamevushshal. aval lo min hamevushshal al sheeno mevushshal. min hatztzalul al sheeno tzalul. aval lo mishsheeno tzalul al hatztzalul. mitteenim al gerogarot beminyan. miggerogarot al hatteenim bemidda. aval lo teenim al gerogarot bemidda. velo gerogarot al hatteenim beminyan. kede sheyyitrom leolam been yafa. vetormin chittim al happat. aval lo min happat al hachittim lefi cheshbon. uvechol ellu im taram terumato teruma: 
En tormin shemen al hazzetim hannichtashin. velo yayin al anavim hannidrachot shezze dome letorem middavar shennigmera melachto al davar shello nigmera melachto. veim taram terumato teruma veyachazor veyitrom min hazzetim vehaanavim bifne atzman. harishona medammaat bifne atzmah vehaochlah chayyav aleha kishar terumot gemurot aval lo min hashsheniyya: 
Mi shettaram shemen al zetim sheddato leachlan. o zetim al zetim vedato al hakkol laachila. o shettaram yayin al anavim shehem laachila. o anavim al anavim vehakkol laachila. venimlach ledarchan vedarach hazzetim vehaanavim shekkevar taram alehem. eno tzarich lachazor velitrom: 
En tormin chometz al yayin. aval tormin yayin al chometz. shehayyayin vehachometz min echad hen. (haya belibbo litrom min hayyayin al hayyayin venimtza beyado chometz enah teruma). haya belibbo litrom chometz al chometz venimtza hachometz shettaram yayin terumato teruma: 
Hattorem chavit shel yayin al hayyayin venimtza chometz im yodea shehayta chometz ad shello teramah enah teruma. veim achar shetteramah hechmitza hare zo teruma. veim safek teruma veyachazor veyitrom. vechen hattorem kishshut venimtzet mara avattiach venimtza saruach o shennimtzeu nekurin. taram chavit shel yayin venimtzet megulla sheasur lishtotah teruma veyachazor veyitrom sheniyya. veen achat mishshetehen medammaat bifne atzmah. vehaochel achat mishshetehen eno chayyav chomesh: 
Ketzad. nafla achat mehen al hachullin enah medammaat. nafla sheniyya lemakom acher enah medammatah. naflu shetehen lemakom echad medammeot bakketanna shebbishtehen. vechen im achal zar shetehen meshallem bakketanna shebbishtehen vechumshah. vechetzad hu ose bishtehen notnan lechohen echad venotel min hakkohen deme haggedola: 
Habbodek et hechavit vehinnichah lehaferishah teruma al acherim ad shettease kullah teruma veyittenenna lakkohen. uleachar zeman bedakah umetzaah chometz. meet shebbedakah techilla ad shelosha yamim vadday yayin vechol yayin shechashav otan hayyamim shehatteruma shello bechavit zo hare hu metukkan. mikkan veelach safek vetzarich lehaferish mimmennu teruma sheniyya: 
Bishlosha perakim tzarich livdok et hayyayin shehinnicho lifrosh alav shemma hechmitz. veellu hen. bekaddim shel motzae hechag. uvehotzaat hassemadar. uvishat kenisat mayim labboser. veyayin miggitto mafrishin alav bechezkat shehu yayin [ad] arbaim yom: 
Hammanniach perot lihyot mafrish alehen ad sheyyeasu teruma af al pi sheen mafrishin lechattechilla ella min hammukkaf im hifrish hare hen bechezkat kayyamin. metzaan sheavdu hare ze choshesh lechol ma shettikken shemma lo hifrish alehen ella achar sheavdu lefichach mafrish teruma sheniyya:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 6: Teruma uterumat maaser neechelet lechohanim ben gedolim ben ketannim ben zecharim ben nekevot hem veavdehem hakkenaanim uvehemtan. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 11)</small> "vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo" vegomer. eved kohen shebbarach veeshet kohen shemmarda hare ellu ochlin:

Teruma shel tora en ochel otah ella kohen meyuchas. aval kohane chazaka ochlin bitruma shel divrehen bilvad. uteruma tehora ben teruma gedola ben terumat maaser ben shel tora ben shel divrehen enah nittenet ella lechohen talmid chacham. mippene sheasur leechol teruma temea. vechol amme haaretz bechezkat tuma lefichach notnin teruma temea lechol kohen sheyyirtze:

Yisreelit shennisset lechohen afillu ketanna bat shalosh shanim veyom echad tochal bitruma vechaze veshok. vedin tora shettochal mishshennitarsa shehare hi kinyano. aval asru chachamim shettochal ad shettikkanes lachuppa gezera shemma taachil teruma leaviha uleacheha keshehi arusa bevet aviha:
Chereshet veshota shennisset lechohen enah ochelet bitruma afillu hissiah aviha gezera shemma yissa cheresh kohen chereshet veyaachilenna. lefichach gazru shello tochal chereshet bat yisrael kelal:

Hazzar asur leechol terumot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 10)</small> "vechol zar lo yochal kodesh" afillu haya toshav kohen o sechiro shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 10)</small> "toshav kohen vesachir lo yochal kodesh". toshav ze sechir olam. sachir ze sechir shanim. veeved ivri hare hu ketoshav vesachir. vechohenet eshet hazzar hare hi kezar shenneemar vechol zar ben hu ben ishto:

Zar sheachal teruma bezadon. ben shehaya tame ben shehaya tahor ben sheachal teruma tehora ben sheachal temea. chayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 9)</small> "umetu vo ki yechalleluhu". veloke al achilatah. veeno meshallem deme ma sheachal sheeno loke umeshallem. veim achal bishgaga mosif chomesh shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 14)</small> "veish ki yochal kodesh bishgaga veyasaf chamishito" vegomer:

Uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hi bitrumat hakodashim lo tochel. shene inyanim nichlelu belav ze. sheim tibbael leasur lah vetease zona o chalala kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure bia hare hi asura leechol bitrumot leolam kedin kol chalal shehechalal kezar lechol davar. veim tinnase leyisrael hare hi asura leechol bammuram min hakkadashim shehu chaze veshok leolam af al pi sheggershah o met:

Aval hatteruma ochelet achar sheggershah hayyisrael o met im lo hinniach ben mimmenna. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 13)</small> "uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha vezera en lah veshava el bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel":
Mippi hashshemua lamdu <small>(Vayikra 22 13)</small> "millechem" velo kol lechem. chozeret hi litruma velo lechaze veshok:
Velo hakkohenet bilvad ella afillu leviyya veyisreelit shennivala leasur lah hoil venaaset zona asura leechol bitruma leolam. veaf al pi sheyyesh lah zera mikkohen:

Lefichach hashshevuya enah ochelet bitruma veaf al pi sheomeret tehora ani. vechol shevuya shenneemenet lomar tehora ani o sheyyesh lah ed kede shettihye mutteret levalah hare zo ochelet bitruma. vehannirbaat livhema lo nifsela min hakkehunna veochelet:

Yisreelit sheyyesh lah zera mikkohen ochelet bishvil benah ben zachar ben nekeva vaafillu tumtum veanderoginus vaafillu zera hazzera ad sof kol haolam shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 13)</small> "vezera en lah":

Keshem shezzera yisrael mikkohenet posel otah kach zera kohen miyyisreelit maachil otah veaf al pi shehu zera pasul. ketzad. bat yisrael shennisset lechohen o kohenet leyisrael veyalda mimmennu bat uva al habbat mi shehu erva aleha o shennisset lemamzer umeta habbat vahare hammamzer kayyam. hayta em immo bat yisrael lechohen tochal bitruma. bat kohen leyisrael lo tochal:

Ha lamadta shehi ochelet bishvil zarah veaf al pi sheoto hazzera pasul vaafillu eno yisrael. veen tzarich lomar sheim hayta lah bat mikkohen af al pi shehabbat nesua leyisrael vaafillu nitchallela hare immah ochelet bishvil habbat happesula:

Kayyotze bo hakkohenet sheenah ochelet mippene zarah shemmiyyisrael af al pi sheoto hazzera kohanim. ketzad. bat kohen shennisset leyisrael veyalda mimmennu bat vehalcha habbat venisset lechohen veyalda mimmennu ben. hare ze rauy lihyot kohen gadol maachil et immo ufosel et em immo veaf al pi shemmeta immo vezot omeret lo keven bitti kohen gadol shehu poslani min hatteruma:

Haeved eno posel mishshum zera veeno maachil. ketzad. kohenet shennisset leyisrael o yisreelit shennisset lechohen veyalda mimmennu ben vehalach habben venichbash al hashshifcha veyalda mimmennu eved umet habben vahare haeved kayyam. hayta em aviv shel eved ze bat yisrael lechohen lo tochal bitruma. hayta bat kohen leyisrael tochal sheen ze zera shehaavadim en lahem yichus:

Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen umet velah mimmennu ben vechazra venisset leyisrael lo tochal bitruma. met hayyisrael velah mimmennu ben lo tochal bitruma mippene benah shemmiyyisrael. met benah miyyisrael ochelet bishvil benah harishon:

Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael veyesh lah mimmennu ben vechazra venisset lechohen tochal bitruma. met velah mimmennu ben tochal bitruma. met benah mikkohen asura leechol mippene benah shemmiyyisrael. met benah shemmiyyisrael chozeret levet aviha kinureha veochelet bitruma lo bechaze veshok:

Bat yisrael shennisset leyisrael techilla veyesh lah mimmennu ben vechazra venisset lechohen ochelet bitruma. met velah mimmennu ben ochelet mippene benah haacharon shehare hu maachilah kemo sheheechilah aviv:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 7: Kohen tame asur leechol teruma ben temea ben tehora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 4)</small> "ish ish mizzera aharon vehu tzarua o zav bakodashim lo yochal". e zehu kodesh sheochlin oto kol zera aharon zecharim unekevot heve omer zo teruma. ella shekkol tame haochel teruma tehora chayyav mita bide shamayim. ulefichach loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 9)</small> "veshamru et mishmarti velo yisu alav chet". vetame sheachal teruma temea af al pi shehu belav eno loke shehare enah kodesh:

En hattemeim ochlin bitruma ad sheyyaariv shimshan veyetzu shelosha kochavim benoniyyim, veze haet kemo shelish shaa achar shekiat hachamma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 7)</small> "uva hashshemesh vetaher" ad sheyyithar harakia min haor <small>(Vayikra 22 7)</small> "veachar yochal min hakkadashim":

Kohen tahor sheachal teruma temea eno loke mippene shehu baase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 7)</small> "veachar yochal min hakodashim" middavar shehu bikdushshato hu sheyyochal kesheyyithar aval davar tame lo yochal af al pi sheyyithar velav habba mikkelal ase ase hu:
Mi shehaya ochel bitruma vehirgish shennizdazeu evarav lehotzi shichvat zera ochez baamma uvolea et hatteruma:

Hacheresh vehashshote matbilin otan umaachilin otan teruma achar sheheeriv shimshan. umeshammerin otan shello yishnu achar hattevila sheim yishnu temeim. ella im ken asu lahem kis shel nechoshet shemma yiru keri:
Rochve gemallim asurin leechol bitruma ad sheyyitbelu veyaariv shimshan shehen bechezkat tuma mippene hachimmum sheharchiva al or haggamal motzi tippa shel shichvat zera:

Hameshammeshet mittatah im lo nithappecha bishat tashmish tovelet veochelet bitruma laerev. veim nithappecha bishat hattashmish hare zo asura leechol bitruma kol shelosha yamim shei efshar lah shello tiflot vetihye temea kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:

Terumat chutza laaretz hoil veikkarah middivrehen enah asura baachila ella lechohen shettuma yotza alav miggufo. vehen baale kerayin vezavin vezavot veniddot veyoldot. vechullan shettavlu muttarin laachila af al pi shello heeriv shimshan. aval temee magga tumot ben shennaga bemet shei efshar lanu hayyom littaher mimmennu ben shennaga besheretz eno tzarich litbol litrumat chutza laaretz:

Lefichach kohen katan sheadayin lo raa keri uketanna sheadayin lo raata dam nidda ochlin otah tamid belo bedika shechezkatan shello yatza tuma adayin alehem. vehametzora hare hu kemi shettuma yotza alav miggufo vehu sheyyetamme oto kohen meyuchas aval kodem sheyyetammeennu hakkohen tahor hu:

Kohen arel asur leechol bitruma middin tora. shehare neemar <small>(Vayikra 22 10)</small> "toshav vesachir" bitruma veneemar toshav vesachir befesach. ma toshav vesachir haamur befesach arel asur bo af toshav vesachir haamur bitruma arel asur bo. veim achal loke min hattora. mashuch muttar leechol bitruma veaf al pi shennire kearel umiddivre sofrim sheyyamul paam sheniyya ad sheyyerae mahul:
Hannolad mahul ochel bitruma. vehattumtum eno ochel mippene shehu sefek arel. veanderoginus mal veochel:
Hearel vechol hattemein af al pi shehen asurin leechol bitruma neshehen veavdehen ochlin:
Petzua dakka ucherut shafcha hem veavdehen ochlin. uneshehen lo yochlu. veim lo yada et ishto mishshennaasa petzua dakka ucherut shafcha hare ellu yochlu. vechen im nasa bat gerim hare zo ochelet:
Petzua dakka kohen shekkiddesh bat kohen enah ochelet. seris chamma hu veishto vaavadav ochlin. tumtum veanderoginus avdehen ochlin aval lo neshotehen:
Cheresh shote vekatan shekkanu lahen avadim enan ochlin. aval im kanu lahem bet din o appotroppos o shennaflu lahen birushsha hare ellu ochlin:

Anderoginus shennival lefasul min hatteruma ben derech zichruto ben derech nekevuto nifsal milleechol bitruma kenashim. veen avadav ochlin. vechen im nival leanderoginus acher shehu posel beviato leishsha nifsal veeno ochel velo maachil avadav. vehu sheyyivol oto derech nekevuto. aval derech zichruto en zachar posel zachar min hakkehunna:
Eved shel shene shuttafin shehaya echad mehen kohen eno maachil hare ze haeved asur leechol. vechol hammaachil bitruma maachil bechaze veshok:

Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen vehichnisah lo ben avde melog ben avde nichse tzon barzel hare ellu yochlu. vechen avde kohen shekkanu avadim veavde ishto shekkanu avadim yochlu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 11)</small> "ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo" afillu kinyan hakkinyan. vekinyan haochel maachil (acherim) vekinyan sheeno ochel eno maachil:
Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael vehichnisa lo ben avde melog ben avde tzon barzel hare ellu lo yochlu:

Almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot ben kohenet ben yisreelit vechen shear chayyave lavin vehichnisa lo avde melog veavdi tzon barzel. avde melog lo yochlu af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotam. veavde tzon barzel yochlu mippene shehem shel baal. nasa sheniyya hi ochelet veavde melog shellah lo yochlu:

Kohenet almana shennitarsa lechohen gadol o gerusha lechohen hedyot hoil vehen meshammerot levia pesula shel tora hare ellu lo yochlu. vechen im nichnesu lachuppa belo erusin enan ochlot shehachuppa posaltan milleechol. nitalmenu o nitgarshu min haerusin chazru lehechsheran veochlot. min hannissuin lo yochlu shekkevar nitchallelu:
Kohenet shemmet balah kohen venafla lifne yevamim sheyyesh bahen chalal lo tochal mippene zikkat hechalal. vaafillu asa bah echad min hakkesherim maamar. sheen hammaamar kone bivama kinyan gamur:

Kohen shennatan get livimto hakkohenet shehare neesra alav vaadayin zikkato aleha hare zo ochelet bitruma mippene shehi meshammeret levia pesula shel divrehen. sheen hagget posel hayevama ella middivrehen. vechen kohenet chalutza o sheniyya shennitarsa lechohen ochelet. kohen hedyot shennasa aylonit hare zo ochelet bitruma:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 8:
Haubbar vehayyavam vehaerusin vehacheresh uven tesha shanim veyom echad poslin velo maachilin: 
Haubbar ketzad. bat yisrael hameubberet mikkohen lo tochal bishvil haubbar. uvat kohen hameubberet miyyisrael asura leechol mippene haubbar. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 13)</small> "veshava el bet aviha kinureha" perat limubberet: 
Bat kohen shebba aleha yisrael en choshshin shemma nitabbera ella tovelet veochelet laerev. hayta nesua leyisrael umet balah tovelet veochelet bitruma laerev ad arbaim yom. veim hukkar ubbarah hare zo mekulkelet lemafrea ad arbaim yom. shekkol haarbaim yom eno ubbar ella mayim baolam hu chashuv: 
Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen umet vehinnichah meubberet lo yochlu avadeha bitruma bishvil haubbar. shehayelud hu shemmaachil sheeno yelud eno maachil. lefichach im haya haubbar chalal eno posel haavadim ella ochlin biglal echav hakkesherim ad sheyyivvaled ze hechalal veyeasru haavadim milleechol: 
Hayyavam ketzad. bat yisrael hazzekuka leyavam kohen lo tochal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 11)</small> "vechohen ki yikne nefesh" veze adayin lo kenaah. uvat kohen hazzekuka leyisrael asura mippene yevamah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 13)</small> "veshava el bet aviha kinureha" perat leshomeret yavam: 
Yavam kohen shebba al yevimto beones o bishgaga o sheheera bah velo gamar af al pi shekkenaah kemo shebbearnu behilchot yibbum eno maachilah bitruma ad sheyyivol beila gemura beratzon. bamme devarim amurim shennitalmena min haerusin. aval min hannissuin hoil vehayta ochelet tochal bevia zo: 
Haerusin ketzad. bat kohen shennitarsa leyisrael asura leechol shehare yesh lo bah kinyan. uvat yisrael shennitarsa lechohen lo tochal ad shettikkanes lachuppa shemma taachil livne bet aviha kemo shebbearnu: 
Yisrael sheamar lechohenet hare at mekuddeshet li achar sheloshim yom hare zo ochelet bitruma kol hashsheloshim sheadayin lo nitarsa. veim amar lah hare at mekuddeshet li meachshav uleachar sheloshim yom hare zo asura leechol miyyad vechen shear hattenaim kayyotze baze: 
Hacheresh ketzad. kohenet shennisset leyisrael cheresh lo tochal shehare kone betakkanat chachamim shettikkenu lo nissuin. uvat yisrael shennisset lechohen cheresh lo tochal sheeno kone min hattora sheeno ben daat: 
Nitarsa lechohen pikkeach velo hispik lechansah ad shennitcharesh enah ochelet. met venafla lifne yavam cheresh veyibbemah enah ochelet. aval im nesaah keshehu pikkeach venitcharesh hare zo ochelet. met venafla lifne yavam cheresh veyibbemah hare zo ochelet hoil vehayta ochelet battechilla. veeshet cheresh sheyyalda mimmennu hare zo ochelet bishvil benah: 
Ben tesha shanim veyom echad ketzad. mi shennivala leasur lah vehu ben tesha shanim veyom echad hoil uviato bia nifsela min hakkehunna vaasura milleechol bitruma mippene shennaaset zona o chalala kemo shebbearnu. afillu haya shachuf. uvat yisrael shennisset lechohen ben tesha shanim veyom echad af al pi shebbiato bia enah ochelet bishvil hakkatan lefi sheeno kone ad sheyyagdil. safek shehu ben tesha shanim veyom echad safek sheeno. nisset leven shelosh esre shana veyom echad safek shehevi shete searot safek shello hevi. hare zo asura leechol: 
Kol ellu keshem sheen maachilin bitruma shel tora kach en maachilin bitruma shel divrehem gezera shemma yaachilu beshel tora: 
Veellu lo poslin velo maachilin. haones. vehamefatte. vehashshote shennasa ishsha. ella im ken hayta asura lahen shehen poslin otah beviatam mippene shennaaset zona vachalala kemo shebbearnu: 
Mi shennisset lechohen shote o sheanas otah o sheppitta otah kohen veyalda ochelet bishvil benah. veaf al pi shehaddavar safek hoil uvelo kiddushin hi shemma meacher nitabbera hare havvalad bechezkat ze shebba aleha. vehu shello yatza aleha kol im acher ella hakkol merannenin achareha beze hakkohen. vechen kohenet shebba aleha yisrael shote o sheanasah o pitta otah venitabbera enah ochelet mippene haubbar. nitchattech haubbar hare zo tochal: 
Eshet ish shebbau aleha ede kinnuy veede setira hare zo asura leechol bitruma ad shettishte me hammarim mippene shehi sefek zona. met balah kodem sheyyashkenna. o shehayta min hannashim sheenan shotot velo notlot ketubba. hare zo asura leechol bitruma leolam. vechol eshet kohen sheamra temea ani hare zo asura leechol bitruma: 
Ketanna bat yisrael shennisset lechohen shello middaat aviha ben bifne aviha ben shello befanav af al pi shekkiddeshah aviha enah ochelet bitruma. sheim micha tease zara lemafrea. veze sheroe veshotek koes hu lefi shennisset shello ledato:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 9:
Haisha ochelet bitruma ad sheyyaggia get leyadah o leyad sheluchah sheasta lekabbala. vechol shehi sefek gerusha hare zo lo tochal. haishsha sheasta shaliach lekabbel lah gittah asura leechol bitruma miyyad. veim amra kabbel li gitti bemakom peloni enah asura ad sheyyaggia shaliach leoto makom. shalcha shaliach lehavi lah gittah ochelet bitruma ad sheyyaggia get leyadah. haomer leishto hare ze gittech shaa achat kodem lemitati asura leechol bitruma miyyad: 
Ir shehikkifuha karkom usefina hammittarefet bayyam vehayyotze liddon hare ellu bechezkat kayyamin. veen tzarich lomar mefaresh veyotze beshayyara. aval ir shekkevashuha karkom usefina sheavda bayyam vehayyotze lehareg mibbatte dine akkum umi sheggerarattu chayya o nafla alav mappolet o shetafo nahar notnin lo chumre metim vechumre chayyim. lefichach im hayu neshotehen bat kohen leyisrael o bat yisrael lechohen hare ellu lo yochlu. aval mi shennigmar dino bevet din vehinnichuhu bevet hassekila lehareg hare ze bechezkat met velo tochal ishto: 
Hinnicha balah goses bimdina acheret ben shehayta kohenet eshet yisrael o yisreelit eshet kohen lo tochal sherov gossin lemita. echad omer met veechad omer lo met hare zo lo tochal: 
Amra lah tzaratah o achat mehechamesh nashim sheenan neemanot lehaidah shemmet balah hoil veenah nisset al pihen hare zo ochelet bitruma bechezkat shebbalah kayyam. ad sheyyaid lah mi shehu neeman lehassiah al piv: 
Hameshachrer et avdo mishsheyyezakke lo beget shichrur pesalo milleechol bitruma. vechol eved sheyyatza lecherut vaadayin hu meukkav get shichrur kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot avadim af al pi chen hare hu asur leechol bitruma: 
Hakkotev nechasav leacher vezikka lo al yede acher vehayu bahen avadim veshatak ze shennatnu lo veachar kach tzavach hare ze safek im ze shetztzavach hochiach sofo al techillato vaadayin lo yatzu mershut rishon o ze shetztzavach achar sheshshatak chazar bo. lefichach en ochlin bitruma ben shehaya rabbo sheni yisrael veharishon kohen ben shehaya rabbo rishon yisrael vehashsheni kohen: 
Yisrael shessachar behema mikkohen maachilah teruma vechohen shessachar behemat yisrael af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonoteha lo yaachilenna teruma mippene sheenah <small>(Vayikra 22 11)</small> "kinyan kaspo": 
Yisrael sheshsham para mikkohen lefattemah velihyot hashshevach benehen lo yaachilenna bitruma af al pi sheyyesh lakkohen chelek beshivchah. aval kohen sheshsham para miyyisrael lefattemah af al pi sheyyesh leyisrael chelek bashshevach hoil vegufah lakkohen shehare shamah al atzmo hare ze maachilah teruma: 
Parato shel yisrael sheyyalda bechor maachilo teruma. shehabbechor lakkohanim. veotzer adam karshine teruma letoch shovacho veeno choshesh shemma yavou hayyonim shello veyochlu otan: 
Yerae li sheim machar hakkohen parato leyisrael velakach haddamim af al pi sheadayin lo mashach hallokeach hare ze asur lehaachilah teruma sheddin tora maot konot kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot mikkach umimkar. veim machar yisrael lakkohen af al pi shennatan haddamim lo tochal bitruma ad sheyyimshoch:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 10: Zar sheachal teruma bishgaga meshallem keren vechomesh. af al pi sheyyodea shehi teruma veshehu muzhar aleha aval lo yada im chayyav aleha mita im lav hare zo shegaga umeshallem keren vechomesh:

Echad haochel davar sheddarko leechol veechad hashshote davar sheddarko lishtot veechad hassach davar sheddarko lasuch shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 15)</small> "velo yechallelu et kadshe bene yisrael" lerabbot et hassach. veechad haochel teruma tehora o temea bishgaga meshallem keren vechomesh. veeno chayyav bechomesh ad sheyyochal kezayit shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 14)</small> "ki yochal kodesh bishgaga" veen achila pechuta mikkezayit. ucheshem sheachilat teruma bichzayit kach shetiyya bichzayit:

Achal vechazar veachal. shata vechazar veshata. im yesh mittechillat achila rishona ad sof achila acharona kede achilat peras umittechillat shetiyya rishona ad sof shetiyya acharona kede shetiyyat reviit hare ellu mitztarfin lichzayit:

Hatteruma uterumat maaser ben shel demay ben shel vadday vehachalla vehabbikkurim kullan mitztarfin lichzayit lechayyev alehen mita vechomesh shekkullan nikreu teruma. umin haddin haya sheen chayyavin chomesh al terumat maaser shel demay kemo sheen chayyavin al maaser [sheni] shello kemo sheyyitbaer. aval amru chachamim im lo yitchayyev aleha chomesh yezalzelu bah:

Achal teruma bemezid [vehitru bo loke veeno meshallem. lo hitru bo] im hayta tehora meshallem hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh. veim hayta temea meshallem deme etzim mippene sheenah reuya ella lehassaka. lefichach im achal terumat tutim verimmonim vechayyotze bahem shennitmeu patur min hattashlumin shehare enam reuyin lehassaka:

Haochel terumat chametz befesach ben bezadon ben bishgaga ben temea ben tehora patur min hattashlumin. afillu hifrishah matztza vehechmitza patur. vaafillu deme etzim eno meshallem shehare enah reuya lehassaka mippene shehi asura bahanaa en lah damim:

Aval hashshogeg sheachal teruma beyom hakkippurim o sheachal teruma nekura. vehashshote yen teruma shennitgalla. vehassach yayin veshemen keechad o sheshshata shemen vechometz keechad o shekkasas et hachittim o gama et hachometz hare ze meshallem keren vechomesh:

Haya savea vekatz bimzono vehosif al savo baachilat teruma eno meshallem et hachomesh shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 14)</small> "ki yochal" lo sheyyazzik et atzmo. vechen hakkoses et hasseorim patur min hachomesh mippene shehizzik atzmo:
Zar shebbala shezafin shel teruma vehekian uva acher vaachalan gam hu bishgaga harishon meshallem keren vechomesh vehashsheni meshallem deme etzim larishon:

Hammaachil happoalim veet haorchim teruma hem meshallemin keren vechomesh mippene shehen keshoggin. vehu meshallem lahem deme seuddatan sheddeme hachullin yeterin middeme teruma sheachlu sheddavar haasur nafsho shel adam chota mimmennu:

Hammaachil et banav hakketannim veet avadav ben gedolim ben ketannim. vehaochel terumat chutza laaretz. vehaochel o hashshote pachot mikkezayit. venazir sheshshagag veshata yayin shel teruma. vehashshote shemen vehassach et hayyayin. kol ellu meshallemim et hakkeren velo et hachomesh:

Bat kohen shehayta nesua leyisrael o shennifsela veachar kach achla teruma meshallemet et hakkeren velo et hachomesh. haishsha shehayta ochelet bitruma veamru lah met balich o gershech. vechen haeved shehaya ochel veamru lo met rabbecha vehinniach yoresh sheeno maachil o shemmecharcha leyisrael o netancha lo o shichrercha. vechen kohen shehaya ochel venoda lo shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza. hare ellu meshallemin hakkeren bilvad. veim hayta terumat chametz vehaya erev happesach hare ellu peturin milleshallem mippene shezzemannah bahul nechpezu leechol velo badku. vechullan shehayta lahen teruma betoch pihen kesheyyadu shehen asurin leechol hare ellu yiflotu:

Haya ochel veamru lo nitmeta. o nitmet hatteruma. tame hayita. o temea hayta hatteruma. o noda shehu tevel o maaser rishon shello nittela terumato. o maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu. o shettaam taam pishpesh letoch piv. hare ellu yiflotu:

Shete kuppot achat shel teruma veachat shel chullin venafla teruma letoch achat mehen veen yadua lee zo nafla hareni omer letoch shel teruma nafla. en yadua e zo hi shel teruma achal zar achat mehen hare ze patur min hattashlumin shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vehashsheniyya noheg bah kitruma. achal acher et hashsheniyya af hu patur. achal echad et shetehen meshallem kakketanna shebbishtehen. im mezid keren. veim shogeg keren vechomesh:

Haochel et hachomesh bishgaga hare ze mosif alav chumsho. shehachomesh kekeren lechol davar. vechen mosif chomesh al chomesh leolam. kol hameshallem keren vechomesh hare hattashlumin kitruma lechol davar. ella sheim nizreu giddulehen chullin. veim ratza hakkohen limchol eno mochel. vechol hameshallem et hakkeren bilvad hare hattashlumin chullin veim ratza hakkohen limchol mochel:

Bat yisrael sheachla teruma veachar kach nisset lechohen. im teruma shello zacha bah kohen achla meshallemet keren vechomesh leatzmah. veim teruma shezzacha bah kohen achla meshallemet keren labbealim vechomesh leatzmah. shekkol hameshallem keren vechomesh meshallem hakkeren labbealim vehachomesh lechol kohen sheyyirtze:
Lo hispika leshallem ad shennitgarsha ben kach uven kach enah meshallemet leatzmah vahare hi kemi shello nisset lechohen meolam:

Kol haochel teruma ben beshogeg ben bemezid eno meshallem ella min hachullin hametukkanim shehotziu mehen terumot umaasrot. umeshallemin min halleket umin hashshichcha umin happea umin hahefker umimmaaser rishon shennittela terumato af al pi sheadayin lo nittela teruma gedola sheyyesh bo im hikdim hammaaser latteruma. umeshallemin mimmaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu veaf al pi shennifdu shello kahalacha. umin hechadash al hayyashan aval lo mimmin al sheeno mino shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 14)</small> "venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh". kakkodesh sheachal:
Haochel kishshuin shel erev sheviit yamtin lakkishshuin shel motzae sheviit vishallem mehen. sheeno yachol leshallem chovo mipperot sheviit kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:

Achal teruma temea meshallem chullin ben temein ben tehorin. achal teruma tehora meshallem chullin tehorin veim shillem chullin temein ben beshogeg ben bemezid tashlumav tashlumin veyachazor vishallem min hattehorin:
Achal terumat chaver meshallem lo. achal terumat am haaretz meshallem lechaver venotel dameha mimmennu venoten leam haaretz sheachal terumato sheen mosrin tohorot leam haaretz:

Gazal teruma meavi immo kohen vaachalah veachar kach met avi immo eno meshallem leatzmo ella leyoresh acher mishshear hashshevet. vechen im nafla lo teruma meavi immo vaachalah. uvaal chov sheggava teruma bechovo vehaishsha bichtubbatah vaachaluha meshallemin keren vechomesh lechohen chaver vehechaver noten lahem damim shehayu mochrin bah otah hatteruma kemo sheachlu:

Haggonev teruma velo achalah meshallem tashlume kefel labbealim. veyesh lo leshallem middeme teruma. genavah vaachalah meshallem shene keranin vechomesh. keren vechomesh min hachullin. vekeren afillu middeme teruma:

Hayta hatteruma hekdesh levedek habbayit ugenavah vaachalah eno meshallem tashlume kefel. sheen tashlume kefel behekdesh kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. aval meshallem keren ushene chomashim. chomesh mishshum ochel teruma. vechomesh mishshum shennehena min hahekdesh. ulemi meshallem. im haya bah kezayit veen bah sheve peruta meshallem lakkohanim. veim yesh bah sheve peruta ben sheyyesh bah kezayit ben sheen bah kezayit meshallem lahekdesh:

Umippene ma chal issur hekdesh al issur hatteruma mippene shehatteruma asura lezar umutteret lakkohen. hikdishah neesra al hakkohen. lefichach nosaf bah issur af al yisrael al derech shebbearnu behilchot biot asurot veissure maachalot:

Haggozel teruma vaachalah meshallem keren vechomesh echad. shehachomesh shechayyav bo mishshum teruma yatza bo yede gezelo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 14)</small> "venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh" eno chayyav ella bechomesh shel kodesh bilvad. gezalah veheechilah leacher. haochel meshallem keren vechomesh. kol makom sheamarnu meshallem keren vechomesh im achal sheve arbaa meshallem sheve chamishsha mimmin sheachal. vechol makom sheamarnu meshallem keren ushene chomashin achal sheve arbaa meshallem shishsha. vechol makom sheamarnu meshallem shene keranin vechomesh echad achal sheve arbaa meshallem deme tisha. uleolam eno meshallem ella lefi damim shehayta shava bishat achila ben shehuzela bishat tashlumin ben shehukera:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 11:
Hatteruma nittenet laachila velishtiyya ulesicha shehassicha hi kishtiyya shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 109 18)</small> "vattavo chammayim bekirbo vechashshemen beatzmotav". vehashshetiyya bichlal achila. leechol davar sheddarko leechol. velishtot davar sheddarko lishtot. velasuch davar sheddarko lasuch. lo yasuch yayin vechometz. aval sach hu et hashshemen hattahor umadlik et hattame vezehu hannikra shemen serefa bechol makom: 
Temarim shel teruma muttar lechavtzan ulekabbetzan keiggul haddevela. veasur laasot mehem shechar. vechen en osin temarim devash velo tappuchim yayin velo perot hassetav chometz. vechen shear kol happerot en meshannin otan mibberiyyatan bitruma chutz mizzetim vaanavim bilvad. avar veasa haochel mashke hare ze shotehu. vezar sheachal devash temarim veyen tappuchim vechayyotze bahen bishgaga eno chayyav leshallem. veim achal bemezid makkin oto makkat mardut: 
En notnin devela ugerogarot letoch hammuryas mippene shehu meabbedan. aval notnin et hayyayin letoch hammuryas. veen mefattemin et hashshemen mippene shehu motzio mikkelal maachalot veosehu shemen mishcha. aval mearvin yayin udevash ufilpelin vechayyotze baellu leachlan: 
En mevashshelin yayin shel teruma mippene shehu memaato. en kovshin betzalim shel teruma bechometz shel teruma mippene shemmafsid hachometz. en mearvin tevua bekitniyyot. vechol davar sheyyitparesh ze mizze keshekkovrin oto mearvin. umishshecharva yehuda hitchilu learev tevua bitvua vekitnit bekitnit aval lo tevua bekitnit: 
Kederech shemmerakkedin et hakkemach bechullin kach noheg hakkohen bitruma. merakked leechol umashlich et hammursan. hare sheratza laasot solet menuppe benafayot harebe ad sheyyotzi kav o kabbayim min hassea lo yashlich et hashshear mippene shehu rauy laachila ella yannichehu bemakom mutzna: 
Shemen shel teruma en chosmin bo tannur vechirayim. veen sachin bo minal vesandal. velo yasuch raglo vehu betoch minal vesandal aval sach et raglo velovesh hamminal o hassandal vesach kol gufo umitaggel al gabbe katovliyya chadasha veaf al pi shehen nissochin eno choshesh. aval lo yitten shemen al gabbe tavla shel shayish lehitaggel aleha mippene shemmeabbedo: 
Kol haochel teruma afillu perot tzarich netilat yadayim af al pi shehayu yadav tehorot kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. veenah neechelet im hazzar al hashshulchan gezera shemma yochal mimmenna. uterumat chutza laaretz neechelet im hazzar al hashshulchan veenah tzericha netilat yadayim kechullin. veen sachin teruma beyadayim mesoavot. nafal al besaro meshafshefo beyadayim mesoavot. aval sachin et hakkatan beshemen teruma betoch shiva. shehannolad kol shiva eno chashuv arel: 
Sach hu hakkohen atzmo beshemen shel teruma umevi ben bitto yisrael umaagilo al gabbav. veim sach atzmo beshemen venichnas lammerchatz muttar lezar lemashcho bammerchatz af al pi shehu nissoch mimmennu: 
Kohenet shechaffa roshah betiltan shel teruma en hayyisreelit mutteret lachof achareha. aval meaggelet searah bisarah. umippene ma hutteru hakkohanim lachof searan betiltan shel teruma mippene sheeno rauy lemaachal adam: 
Uktze teenim ugerogarot vehakkelisim vehecharuvin umee avattiach ukelippe avattiach veetrog umelaffon af al pi sheen bahen ochel ukenivat yarak shemmashlichin baale battim hare ellu asurim lezarim. aval kenivat yarak shemmekannevim haggannanin mutteret lezarim. kelippe polin veshumshemin im yesh bahen ochel asurin. en bahen ochel muttarin: 
Garine etrog muttarim. garine zetim utemarim vecharuvin af al pi shello kenasan hakkohen hare ellu asurin lezarim. ushear haggarinin bizman shekkenasan veyesh bahen lachluchit limtzotz otan asurin lezar veim hishlichan muttarot: 
Hassubbin shel chittim chadashot asurin mippene shehu rauy lemaachal adam. veshel yeshanot muttar. vead matay nikreu chadashot kol zeman shebbene adam regilin lachbot ben haggoranot: 
Hannetzolot veharakvaniyyot shel teruma asurot veim heelu avak muttarot. shemarim shel teruma shennatan alehem mayim harishon vehashsheni asur lezarim vehashshelishi muttar veim lo natan alehem mayim ella mesannen hayyayin meal hashshemarim bilvad af hashshelishi asur lezarim: 
Megura sheppinna mimmenna chitte teruma en mechayyevin oto lihyot yoshev umelakket achat achat veachar kach yitten letochah chullin ella mechabbed kedarko venoten letochah chullin. vechen chavit shel shemen teruma shennishpecha en mechayyevin oto lihyot yoshev umetappeach ella noheg bah kederech shennoheg bechullin: 
Hameare kad shel shemen teruma hare ze meare ad sheyyifsok haammud veyatchil hashshemen lintof meat meat vechevan shennatfu shalosh tippim zo achar zo dayyo. umuttar litten bechad shemen chullin. hare shello natan ella hinniach hakkad ad shennitmatztzet otah hattamtzit teruma: 
Memalle hakkohen ner shemen serefa venotno leyisrael laalot bo laaliyya ulehikkanes lacheder laasot tzarche hakkohen aval lo tzarche yisrael. veim haya shuttaf immo muttar: 
Yisrael shehaya oreach etzel kohen vehidlik lo shemen serefa veamad hakkohen vehalach lo eno chayyav lechabboto ad shekkave meelav vetovel hayyisrael petila bener hakkohen umadlik lelech bah: 
Bekaro shel kohen shehaya omed etzel bekaro shel yisrael. vechelav shel kohen shehaya neerag etzel kelav shel yisrael. hare ze madlik alehen shemen serefa shello birshut hakkohen. vechen madlikin shemen serefa bevatte kenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot uvammevoot haafelim shello birshut kohen. umi sheen lo chullin lehadelik ner chanukka madlik shemen serefa shello birshut hakkohen. madlikin shemen serefa al gabbe hachullin birshut kohen: 
Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen vehi lemuda etzel aviha madlik birshutah. muttar lechohen lehadelik shemen serefa afillu bevet haavel o bevet hammishte sheyyesh sham irbuv. veen choshshin shemma yesuppeku mimmenna bevet hammishte shemmippene nikyon kelehem en nogin bo. uvevet haavel mippene sheen lahem penay mippene haavel: 
Hazzorea et hatteruma beshogeg yehappech bemezid yekayyem. hevia shelish ben bemezid ben beshogeg yekayyem. veim haya pishtan afillu hevia shelish vaafillu bemezid yehappech. kenas kansu bo shello yizra veyitkavven lehanot beetzav: 
Giddule teruma hare hen kechullin lechol davar ella sheasurim lezarim. gazru chachamim alehen sheyyihyu asurin lezarim kitruma mishshum teruma temea shebbeyad hakkohen shello yashhenna etzlo kede sheyyizraenna vetetze lechullin venimtza ba bah lide takkala. lefichach muttar leechol haggiddulin beyadayim temeot umuttar litvul yom kechullin: 
Giddule giddulin chullin lechol davar. vaafillu davar sheen zaro kale im rabbu haggiddulin al haikkar begiddule haggiddulin hare haggiddulin hashsheniyyim maalin et haikkar af al pi sheen zaro kale veyihye hakkol muttar lezarim. vechen terumat chutza laaretz vehamedumma vetosefet teruma vezerone ginna sheenam neechalim kegon zera lefet utzenon af al pi sheoto lefet utzenon teruma giddulehen muttarin vahare hen chullin lechol davar. vechen hazzorea pishtan shel teruma haggiddulin muttarin lezarim: 
Hazzorea teruma temea af al pi shehaggiddulim tehorin hare hen asurin baachila. hoil vehatteruma shennizrea asura baachila hayta kevar niddechu: 
Chatach et healin shetztzamchu veyatzu alin sheniyyin vachatachan hare ochel sheyyatza achar kach muttar baachila: 
Shetile chullin shennitmeu uzeraan vaasaan teruma hare ellu muttarin. shehare taharu bizria velo nitmeu keshehen teruma kede sheyyihyu asurin: 
Shibbolet shehayta betoch hakkeri umerach hakkeri kullo hare otah hashshibbolet tevel. hoil venimrecha betoch hakkeri. shetalah veachar kach kara aleha shem vaasaah teruma hare zo sefek teruma hoil uzeraah. shemma parach hattevel mimmenna venaaset keferot sheadayin lo nigmeru. aval im asaah teruma kodem sheyyizraenna hare zo teruma. lefichach im talash mimmenna veachal bemezid chayyav mita. beshogeg meshallem et hachomesh. veim gachan veachal befiv min haaretz betela dato etzel kol adam. sheen derech bene adam bechach. lefichach patur min hammita umin hachomesh im haya shogeg: 
Sade shel giddule teruma chayyevet beleket shichcha ufea uvitruma umaasrot uvemaasar ani. vaaniyye yisrael vaaniyye kohanim notlim mimmenna mattanot ellu. aniyye kohanim ochlin et shellahem vaaniyye yisrael mochrin et shellahem lakkohanim bidme teruma vehaddamim shel aniyyim. vechen ben levi mocher hammaaser shello lakkohanim: 
Hachovet giddulin ellu meshubbach. vehaddash bivhema ketzad yaase. tole kefifot betzavvere behema venoten letochan meoto hammin. nimtza lo zomem et habbehema velo maachil et hatteruma:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 12:
Asur letamme et hatteruma shel eretz yisrail kishar hakkadashim velo yevienna lide tuma velo yafsidenna ella ochel hattehora umadlik hattemea. umuttar letamme terumat chutza laaretz betumot shel tora. veaf al pi sheenah temea ella beeretz haammim shehi middivrehem mippene sheikkar chiyyuvah middivrehem. lefichach nidda kotza lah challa bechutza laaretz sheenah muzheret ella leachlah lo ligga bah kemo shebbearnu: 
Teruma shennitmet besafek lo ochlim velo sorfin ella tihye munnachat ad shettitma tuma vaddait vetissaref. veyesh sham sefekot shessorfin alehen et hatteruma kemo sheyyitbaer beinyan tuma vetohora: 
Chavit shel teruma shennolad lah sefek tuma hare ze lo yechaddesh bah davar. lo yezizenna mimmekomah velo yegallenna ella yannichenna ad shettittame vadday vetissaref. veen choshshin shemma teachel: 
Chavit shennishbera baggat haelyona vehattachtona temea. im yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora yatztzil veim lav yatztzil beyadav belo netilat yadayim veaf al pi shehu metammeah kemo sheyyitbaer beinyan tohorot: 
Bamme devarim amurim bechavit shel yayin vehu sheyyihye baggat hattachtona pachot mimmea shehare yiddama hakkol veyippasel. aval im haya battachtona mea bezo hechavit shehare hi ola beachat umea. o shehayta chavit shel shemen. tered vetittame veal yetammeenna beyadav shehare hakkol rauy lehadelaka veen sham hefsed merubbe. vechen chavit shemen shennishpecha im yachol lehatztzil reviit betohora yatztzil veim lav yatztzil betuma. shekkevan shennishbera hechavit eno muzhar shello lehatztzil betuma mippene shehu bahul: 
Haya over mimmakom lemakom uveyado kikkarot shel teruma. amar lo hannachri ten li achat mehen veim lav hareni nogea bechullan umetammean yanniach lefanav achat al hassela veal yittenenna letoch yado kede shello yetamme hatteruma beyadayim: 
Hattiltan vehakkarshinin shel teruma hoil veeno maachal adam hare ze muttar laasot kol maasehen betuma. veeno nizhar ella beet sheriyyatan bemayim. sheim shara otam betuma hare timme otam beyadayim. aval achar hashsheriyya eno nizhar. lo beet sheshshaf hakkarshinin velo beet shemmaachilan livhema. lefichach notnin terumat tiltan vecharshinin lechohen am haaretz: 
En mafkidin teruma etzel kohen am haaretz mippene shellibbo gas bah leachlah. aval mafkidin oto etzel yisrael am haaretz bichli cheres hammukkaf tzemid patil. uvilvad shello yihyu perot muchsharin. gezera shello tesitem ishto nidda: 
En osin leam haaretz terumat zetav betohora. aval osin lo zete chullin betohora mishshum kede chayyav shel badad (levad). vechetzad ose. notel kede hatteruma umannichah bichli sheeno mekabbel tuma kegon keli avanim. uchesheyyavo am haaretz littol hachullin vehatteruma omrin lo hizzaher shemma tigga batteruma shello tachazor letivlah: 
Yisrael sheose perotav betuma en botzrin immo. veen tzarich lomar sheen dorchin immo mippene hatteruma shettease betuma. aval molichin immo chaviyyot laggat umeviin min haggat: 
Zetim vaanavim shennitmeu sochatan veose otan teruma. veim nitmeu achar shennaasu teruma vesochatan pachot pachot mikkabbetza hare hammashke hayyotze mehen muttar bishtiyya lakkohanim. vaafillu linsachim haya rauy shehammashke keillu hu mufkad betoch haochel. velo amru pachot pachot mikkevetza ella gezera shemma yaase yoter mikkabbetza venimtza hammashke mittetamme bichvetza. veim hayu perot ellu shelishi letuma dorchan begat uvevet habbad vehammashke teruma tehora. sheen shelishi ose revii bitruma kemo sheyyitbaer beinyan tohorot: 
Pat teruma shennitmet mashlichah leven haetzim ad sheyyisrefenna. vechen shemen shennitma notno bichli maus ad sheyyadlik kede shello yihye takkala laacherim veyochluhu. vechittim shennitmeu sholkan umannichan bichli maus kede shello yihyu reuyin laachila veachar kach yassik bahen tannur vechirayim. umashkin sheen reuyin lehadelaka shennitmeu kegon hayyayin kovrin otan: 
Yen teruma shennitgalla hoil veasur bishtiyya yishshafech. vechen teenim vaanavim vekishshuim vedilluin vaavattichin umelaffonot shel teruma shennimtzeu menukkarot hare ellu asurin baachila mippene sakkanat nefashot. ma yaase bahen yashlich layyam o yikkavru: 
Issa shennillosha bemayim megullim af al pi shehi teruma tissaref: 
Asur lechohen littol teruma o shear mattanot shello ad sheyyafrishu otam habbealim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 12)</small> "reshitam asher yittenu laAdonai lecha netattim" veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 19)</small> "asher yarimu vene yisrael laAdonai natatti lecha" ad sheyyarimu veachar kach yizke bahem. velo yitlem achar shehuremu ella middaat bealim shehare hem shel bealim littenan lechol kohen sheyyirtzu shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 10)</small> "veish et kodashav lo yihyu". veim lakach shello middaat bealim zacha bahen sheen labbealim mehen ella tovat hanaa vetovat hanaa enah mamon: 
Kohen shennatnu lo teruma umatza bah devarim acherim hare ellu asurim mishshum gezel shemma acherim hinnichum sham ad sheyyittelum: 
En yisrael chayyavin lehittafel batteruma velahaviah min haggoren lair umin hammidbar layyishshuv ella kohanim yotzin logoranot veyisrael notnim lahem chelkan sham. veim lo yatzu hare ze mafrish umannichah baggoren. veim hayta chayya o behema ochaltah sham veenah mishtammeret sham mehem hitkinu chachamim sheyyitafel bah vivienna lair veyittol sechar havaatah mikkohen. sheim hifrishah vehinnichah livhema ulechayya hare ze chillul hashshem: 
Asur lechohanim uleviyyim lesayyea bevet haggoranot kede littol mattenotehen. vechol hamesayyea chillel kodesh hashshem. vaalehem neemar <small>(Malachi 2 8)</small> "shichattem berit hallevi". veasur leyisrael lehannicho sheyyesayyeehu ella noten lahem chelkan bechavod: 
Natan teruma lechohen al menat lehachazirah yatza yede netina. veasur laasot ken mippene shennimtza kimsayyea bevet haggoranot. vechen asur lahen sheyyachtefu terumot umaasrot vaafillu lishl chelkan befihen asur ella notlin bechavod. sheal shulchan hammakom hem ochlin veal shulchano hem shotim umattanot ellu laAdonai hem vehu zikka lahen shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 8)</small> "vaani natatti lecha et mishmeret terumotay": 
Lo yitten adam teruma leshomer gitto. velo bechor leshomer edro. velo mattanot leroe behemto. veim natan chillel ella im ken natan lahem sechar shemiratan techilla. verashshay yisrael lomar leyisrael acher ha lecha sela zo veten teruma o bechor o shear mattanot lifloni hakkohen ben bitti o ben achoti. vechol kayyotze baze: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayu habbealim rotzim litten otam leechad mishshene kohanim ellu o leechad mishshene leviyyim ellu bechinnam veamar lo chavero he lecha veten laze. aval habbealim sheamru lakkohen o lallevi he lecha chelek ze betovat hanaa hare ze asur. vechen asur laasot sechora bitrumot af al pi shehu lokeach mikkohen umocher lechohen: 
Asara en cholkin lahen teruma bevet haggoranot af al pi shehen ochlin otah o maachilin otah. veellu hen. hacheresh. vehashshote. vehakkatan sheen bo daat lifrosh chukko. mippene sheen beellu daat. vehattumtum vehaanderoginus mippene shehen beriyya bifne atzman. vehaeved shemma yiruhu haovrim bassade veyaidu alav shehu kohen. vehearel vehattame mippene shehen meusin. vehaishsha shemma titgaresh umippene hayyichud. vehannose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo kansu oto shello yachalok bevet haggoranot ad sheyyegarshenna. vechullan meshallechin lahen levattehen vecholkin lahen kishar kadshe haggevul. chutz min hannose ishsha sheenah hogenet lo vehattame vehearel sheen meshallechin lahen kelal:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 13: Hatteruma ola beechad umea. ketzad. sea teruma shennafla lemea sea shel chullin venitarev hakkol mafrish min hakkol sea achat venotnah lakkohen vehashshear muttar lezarim. vechol teruma sheen hakkohanim makpidin aleha kegon terumat hakkelisin vehecharuvin vehasseorim shel edom eno tzarich lehagebiah hoil venafla bemea batla bemiutah vehakkol muttar lezarim:

Nafla sea teruma lefachot mimmea naase hakkol medumma veyimkor hakkol lakkohanim bidme teruma chutz middeme otah sea. bamme devarim amurim keshennitarev min bemino. aval min besheeno mino benoten taam im yesh bakkol taam teruma naasa hakkol medumma veyimmacher lakkohanim chutz middeme teruma shebbo. veim taam hakkol taam chullin hakkol muttar lezarim:

Sea teruma shennafla lemea vehigbiah sea min hakkol venafla hassea shehigbiah lemakom acher enah medammaat ella lefi cheshbon. vechen sea teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea venaasa hakkol medumma venafal min hamedumma lemakom acher eno medammea ella lefi cheshbon. ketzad. hare shennaflu eser sein shel teruma letishim sea chullin venidmeu hakkol im nafal mimmedumma ze eser sein lefachot mimmea chullin nidmeu shehare yesh beeser shel medumma sea shel teruma. nafal letochan pachot meeser sein enan medammeot:

Bamme devarim amurim bedavar sheen darko lehibbalel kegon chittim lechittim o kemach lekemach. aval darko lehibbalel kegon shemen teruma leshemen chullin o yen teruma leyen chullin holchin achar harov. im rov teruma hare ze medammea kitruma. veim rov chullin hare hu kechullin veeno medammea af al pi shehakkol asurim lezarim:

Sea teruma shennafla lemea higbihah venafla acheret higbihah venafla acheret hare hachullin muttarin ad shettirbe teruma alehen. sheim naflu letoch hammea chullin mea sea veod shel teruma sea achar sea naasa hakkol medumma:

Sea teruma shennafla lemea velo hispik lehagebihah ad shennafla sea acheret. im yada barishona kodem shettippol hashsheniyya lo nidmeu. ella mafrish satayim vehashshear muttar hoil vehaya lah laalot hare hi keillu alta. veim lo yada bisa rishona ella achar shennafla hashsheniyya hare ze medumma ucheillu naflu shetehen keachat:

En pesolet shel teruma mitztarefet immah leesor hachullin. aval pesolet hachullin mitztarefet im hachullin lehaalot hatteruma. ketzad. sea chittim yafot shel teruma shennafla lemea sea chittim raot shel chullin vetachan hakkol. af al pi shehammursan shel chullin merubbin veshel teruma muat vahare kemach shel teruma befachot mimmea mikkemach hachullin hare ze ole umeshaarin bekemach im hammursan shehu mea veechad. aval im nafla sea chittim raot shel teruma lefachot mimmea sea chittim yafot shel chullin vetachan hakkol vahare hakkemach shel teruma echad mimmea mikkemach hachullin hare ze ole bemea veechad shehare hotiru hachullin ufachata hatteruma:
Log yayin shel teruma tzalul shennafal lemea login achurin en motziin shemarim shebbahem. ella maalin et hallog. vechen im nafal log achur lemea login tzelulin en motziin shemarim shebbo:
Log mayim shennafal letishim vetisha login yayin veachar kach nafal letoch hakkol log yayin shel teruma nidma hakkol. sheen hammayim maale et hayyayin:

Sea teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea chullin venaflu chullin acherim ad shehosifu al mea. im beshogeg hare zo ola bemea veechad. veim bemezid hare hakkol medumma sheen mevattelin issure tora lechattechilla:

Terumat chutza laaretz muttar levattelah berov veochlah bime tumato velo od ella im haya lo yayin shel terumat chutza laaretz notel mimmennu log echad venoten alav shene login chullin venimtza hakkol shelosha veachar kach notel miyyayin shel teruma log venoten letoch hashshelosha umagbiah mearbatan log veshote. vechozer umashlich letochan log acher vechozer venotel log veshote. vechen noten log teruma venotel log min hattaarovet ad sheyyichle kol hayyayin shel teruma. venimtza shennatal kamma login bishne login shel chullin:

Hazzorea teruma betzad hachullin velo noda e zehu zera teruma afillu haya mea leginna shel teruma uleginna achat shel chullin kullan muttarin. bamme devarim amurim bedavar shezzaro kale bakkarka kegon hachittim vehasseorim vechayyotze bahen. aval davar sheen zaro nifsad baaretz kegon hashshum vehabbetzalim afillu mea leginna shel chullin uleginna achat shel teruma taarovet benehen hare hakkol medumma. veim nitlash hakkol taale hatteruma beechad umea velo yitlosh lechattechilla:

Shete kuppot achat shel teruma veachat shel chullin veen yadua e zo hi. o shennafla sea shel teruma letoch achat mehen veen yadua lehechan nafla veachar kach nafla achat mishshete kuppot letoch hachullin enan medammatan. vechen im zara achat mehem haggiddulin chullin lechol davar. vehashsheniyya noheg bah kitruma. nafla hakkuppa hashsheniyya lemakom acher enah medammaat. vechen im zara acher et hashsheniyya haggiddulin chullin. naflu shetehen lemakom echad medammaat kakketanna shebbishtehen. zara echad et shetehem bedavar shezzaro kale haggiddulin chullin. uvedavar sheen zaro kale haggiddulin medumma. bamme devarim amurim bezorea et hashsheniyya ad shello katzar et harishona. aval katzar et harishona veachar kach zara et hashsheniyya afillu bedavar sheen zaro kale haggiddulin chullin sheen talush umechubbarin naasin chova ze laze:

Shete kuppot achat shel chullin veachat shel teruma velifnehen shete sein achat shel chullin veachat shel teruma venaflu ellu letoch ellu muttarin. sheani omer chullin letoch chullin naflu uteruma letoch hatteruma veaf al pi shello rabbu chullin al hatteruma. bamme devarim amurim bitruma bazzeman hazze shehu middivrehem. aval bitruma shel tora ad sheyyirbu chullin al hatteruma:

Sea teruma shennafla letoch hakkeri veamar terumat hakkeri ze letocho bemakom shennafla otah sea sham nistayyema terumat hakkeri venidma hakkol bitruma shennafla uvitrumat hakkeri. amar terumat hakkeri bitzfono cholkin oto lishnayim vehachetzi shebbatztzafon lishnayim venimtza revia hakkeri shehu tzefon tzefoni hu hamedumma:

Hayu lefanav shene kerayim veamar terumat shene kerayim beechad mehen hare shenehen medummain. hayu lefanav shete sein ucheri echad veamar hare achat min hassein haellu asuya teruma al hakkeri hazze hare achat mehen teruma veen yadua e zo hi. hayu lefanav shene kerayim usea achat veamar hare zo teruma al echad min hakkerayim hallalu hare hu teruma venitkan echad mehen veen yadua e ze hu hametukkan min hattevel:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 14:
Chamishim teenot shichorot vachamishshim levanot shennafla letochan teena achat shel teruma. hayta levana hashshechorot muttarot vehallevanot medummaot. hayta shechora hashshechorot medummaot vehallevanot muttarot. veim en yadua im shechora hayta veim levana ola beechad umea min hakkol. yada me hayta achar shennafla veshachach hare kullan medummaot: 
Vechen iggule devela umalbenim shel devela shennafal iggul o malben shel teruma letochan veen yadua im malben haya o iggul hare haiggulin mitztarfin lammalbenim vetaale hatteruma beechad umea min hakkol. iggule devela gedolim uketannim shennafal iggul devela letochan veen yadua im gadol haya im katan hare hen maalin ben beminyan ben bemishkal. ketzad. nafal iggul lemea iggulin gedolim uketannim hareni omer katan nafal umagbiah echad min hakketannim. nafal iggul letoch arbaim iggulim mehen esrim iggul mishkal kol echad arba litrin umehen esrim iggul mishkal kol echad litra hoil umishkal hakkol mea litrin veechad hareni omer katan nafal umagbiah echad min hakketannim: 
Vehakkemach vehassolet enan mitztarfin lehaalot et hatteruma: 
Sea shel chittim shennafla al pi megura shel chittim en meshaarin otah beechad umea. sheen meshaarin ella im nivlela teruma im hachullin. o im en yadua beeze makom nafla hatteruma. vechetzad yaase. roin et hatteruma keillu hi chittim al gabbe seorim umafrish hatteruma atzmah shennafla al gabbe hammegura im meat min hachullin shennafla alehen kemi shemmeassef chittim meal gabbe seorin: 
Shete kuppot o shete megurot shennafla teruma letoch achat mehen venivlela veen yadua lee zo mehen nafla. im hayu shete megurot bevayit echad hare ellu mitztarfot vetaale beechad umea min hakkol keillu hayu shetehen megura achat vehakkuppot mitztarfot. vaafillu hayta kuppa bevayit ze vekuppa bevayit acher lefi shekkarov haddavar lekabbetz shetehen bevayit echad. aval im hayu shete hakkuppot bishte ayarot enan mitztarfot: 
Vechetzad maale sea shennafla. im ratza lehaalot meechad mishshetehen maale veim ratza lehaalot chetzyah mizzo vechetzyah mizzo maale. kaddim meleim teenim shel chullin sheddaras litra teenim shel teruma befi kad echad mehem veen yadua e zo hi im hayu sham mea kad vechad hare zo taale velokeach kad echad mehem umochrah lakkohen chutz middeme otah litra vehashshear muttarin. veim hayu pachot mimmea happumin kullan medummaot vehashshulayim muttarin: 
Vechen im derasah al pi kavveret o al pi iggul veen yadua e ze hu. derasah al pi haiggul veen yadua im bitzfono o bidromo velo e zo iggul hu. roin otam keillu hem perudot vetaale lefi hammishkal. im yesh bechol haiggulin mea litrin taale. vehu sheyyesh bechol iggul mehen yeter al shene litrin kede shettibbatel hatteruma berov. shessefek hatteruma batel berov hachullin: 
Hatteruma vaddaah oser bemea usefekah oser bachamishshim. veen lah hetter ella berov. veim haya beyoter mechamishshim enah tzericha rov. ketzad. teena achat teruma shennafla letishim vatesha vahare hammea kayyamin hakkol asur lezarim kemo shebbearnu: 
Nafla achat mechamishshim veavda achat min hakkol shemma achat min hachullin hi sheavda o haachat shennafla hi sheavda hare ellu asurot ad sheyyarbe alehen chullin mimmakom acher veyosif alehen chamishshim teenim veachat yoter al hakkol. veim nafla achat shel teruma letoch chamishshim veachat veavda achat min hakkol huttar hashshear lezarim: 
Sea teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea maaser rishon shello nittela terumato o lemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu venidma hakkol im lemaaser rishon nafla yikra shem litrumat maaser veyimkor hakkol lakkohanim chutz middeme teruma shennafla umiddeme terumat maaser shebbo. veim lemaaser sheni vehekdesh nafla hare ellu yippadu veyimmachru lakkohen chutz middeme teruma: 
Sea teruma temea shennafla lefachot mimmea chullin o mimmaaser rishon o maaser sheni o hekdesh ben temein ben tehorim hoil venidma hakkol hare hakkol kitruma temea sheasura baachila lakkol vahare hakkol asur leolam umannichim otan ad sheyyerakvu. bamme devarim amurim bedavar sheen darko leheachel chay. aval bedavar sheddarko leheachel chay lo yannichan shemma yittakel bahem veyochal mehen. ella yadlik hakkol kederech shemmadlikin teruma temea: 
Sea teruma tehora shennafla lefachot mimmea chullin temein yimmacher hakkol lakkohanim chutz middeme teruma vehakkohen ochel medumma ze kelayot. o yalush oto beme perot sheenan machshirin kede shello tittame hatteruma shebbo min hachullin hattemein. o yalush medumma ze pachot mikkabbetza sheen ochel tame metamme ochel acher ad sheyyihye kabbetza. o yitchallek medumma ze pachot mikkabbetza bechol issa kede shello tittame hatteruma shebbo: 
Sea teruma temea shennafla lemea chullin tehorin. vechen sea teruma tehora shennafla lemea chullin temein. taale beechad umea veteachel kelayot o tillosh beme perot o pachot mikkabbetza. sheen hassea shennafla hi hassea atzmah shealta: 
Sea teruma temea shennafla lemea sea shel teruma tehora batla bemiut veochlin hakkol betohora. veim nafla lefachot mimmea yanniach hakkol ad sheyyerakev: 
Shete kuppot shennafla sea shel teruma letoch achat mehen venoda lee zo mehen nafla veachar kach nafla sea sheniyya veen yadua lee zo mehen nafla. omrim lemakom shennafla rishona nafla sheniyya lefi shettolin et hakkalkala bamkulkal. nafla sea rishona letoch achat mehem veen yadua lee zo mehen nafla veachar kach nafla sea sheniyya venoda lee zo mehen nafla. en omrim lemakom shennafla sheniyya nafla rishona ella shetehen mekulkalot: 
Hayu shete kuppot achat temea veachat tehora venafla sea shel teruma leachat mehen veen yadua e zo hi omrin letoch hattemea nafla: 
Shete kuppot achat teruma tehora veachat shel chullin temein nafla sea teruma tehora letoch achat mehen omrin letoch shel teruma nafla vehachullin yeachlu betohora kitruma: 
Nafla sea teruma temea letoch achat mehen omrin letoch shel teruma nafla vehachullin yeachlu kelayot betohora kitruma gedola: 
Sea teruma temea shennafla letoch achat mehen omrin letoch shel teruma nafla vehachullin yeachlu kelayot o yilloshu beme perot: 
Shete kuppot achat shel teruma temea veachat shel chullin tehorin venafla sea shel teruma tehora letoch achat mehen omrin letoch shel teruma nafla vehachullin yeachlu kelayot: 
Nafla sea shel teruma temea letoch achat mehen shetehen asurot shessefek teruma temea asur usefek hamedumma muttar mippene sheissur teruma temea min hattora veissur hamedumma middivrehen al haikkarim shebbearnu behilchot issure maachalot:
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 15:
Chavit setuma medammaat bichol shehu. ketzad. chavit setuma shel teruma shennitarva bechamma alafim chaviyyot setumot nidma hakkol. niftechu hechaviyyot taale beechad umea: 
Chavit setuma shennitarva bammea chaviyyot venafla achat mehem layyam haggadol hutteru kullan veomrin shel teruma hi shennafla. ma sheen ken bitena shennafla lemea venafla achat mehen layyam haggadol ella tzarich lehaferish achat. lefi shehechavit nefilatah nikkeret uteena vechayyotze bah en nefilatah nikkeret: 
Chavit setuma shennitarva bemea chaviyyot veniftecha achat mehen notel mimmenna echad mimmea veshote otah hechavit. aval shear hechaviyyot asurot ad sheyyippatchu. vechol achat veachat shettippatach mehen notel mimmenna kede dimmuah veshote hammea hashshear. nitarva chavit bemea vachamishshim chaviyyot veniftechu mehem mea notel mehem kede dimmua chavit achat veshote hammea ushear hachamishshim asurot veen machazikin leotah chavit shel teruma shehi berov afillu hayu kamma alafim chaviyyot kullan medumma vechol ma sheyyiftach notel hemennu echad mimmea vehashsheyarim shote vehashshear medumma: 
Kevar bearnu behilchot issure maachalot shehamechammetz vehametabbel oser bechol shehu. lefichach im rissek tappuach shel teruma unetano letoch haissa vehechmitza kol haissa medummaat vaasura lezarim: 
Betza shennitbela betavlin shel teruma afillu chelmon shellah asur mippene shehu bolea: 
Seor shel teruma shennafal letoch haissa vehigbiho veachar kach nitchammetza hare zo mutteret: 
Kevar bearnu sheim nitarev (teruma) min besheeno mino benoten taam lefichach batzal mechuttach shennitbashshel im hattavshil im habbatzal teruma vehattavshil chullin veyesh bo taam habbatzal hare hattavshil asur lezarim. veim habbatzal chullin vehattavshil teruma venimtza taam hattavshil babbatzal hare habbatzal asur: 
Adashim shennitbashshelu veachar kach hishlich letochan batzal yavesh im haya shalem hare ze muttar. veim haya mechuttach benoten taam. veim bishshel habbatzal im haadashim ben shalem ben mechuttach meshaarin oto benoten taam. ushear kol hattavshil ben shehishlich habbatzal achar shennitbashshel ben shebbishshelo im hattavshil ben shalem ben mechuttach meshaarin oto benoten taam. umippene ma batzal shalem letoch adashim shennitbashshelu en meshaarin oto. mippene sheeno shoev mehen shehare hu shalem velo polet letochan shekkevar nitbashshelu. veim hayu betzalim rakkim hare hen kimchuttach. vechen im notel pitmato ukelippato hachitzona o shehaya lach hare hu kimchuttach. vehakaflut ben lach ben yavesh ben shalem ben mechuttach benoten taam: 
Hakkovesh yarak shel chullin im yarak shel teruma hare ze muttar lezarim. chutz mimmine betzalim vechatzir veshumim. sheim kavash yarak shel chullin im betzalim shel teruma o betzalim chullin im betzalim shel teruma hare ellu asurin. kavash yarak shel teruma im batzal shel chullin hare habbatzal muttar lezarim: 
Zete chullin shekkevashan im zete teruma. im hayu petzuin ellu veellu. o shehayu chullin petzuin veshel teruma shelemin. o shekkevashan beme teruma. hare ellu asurin. aval im hayu shenehen shelemin. o shehayu zete teruma petzuin vezete hachullin shelemin. hare ellu muttarin lefi shehappetzuin shoavot min hashshelemin: 
Me kevashim ume shelakot shel teruma hare hen asurin lezarim: 
Hashshevet ad shello natna taam bakkedera yesh bah mishshum teruma. mishshennatna taam bakkedera en bah mishshum teruma:
