Harode pat chamma unetanah al pi chavit shel yen teruma. im hayta pat chittim hare zo mutteret. veshel seorim asurim mippene sheshshoavot: 
Tannur shehissiko bechammon shel teruma veafa bo et happat happat mutteret sheen bah taam kammon ella recho vehareach eno asur: 
Seorin shel teruma shennaflu levor shel mayim af al pi shehivishu memav hare hen muttarin sheen noten taam lifgam oser: 
Tiltan shel teruma hu veetzo shennafal letoch bor shel yayin im yesh bezera hattiltan kede litten levaddo taam bayyayin hare hayyayin asur lezarim: 
Shene kosot shel yayin echad teruma veechad chullin mazag kol echad bemayim veachar kach ervan. roin et yen hachullin keillu eno ucheillu yen hatteruma shennitarev bemayim shehare eno mino. im rauy oto hammayim levattel taam yen hatteruma hare hakkol muttar lezarim. veim lav asur. shekkevar bearnu sheen hammayim maalin et hayyayin: 
Yayin shel teruma shennafal al gabbe perot yedichem vehem muttarot. vechen shemen shel teruma shennafal al gabbe perot yedichem vehem muttarot. nafal hashshemen al gabbe yayin yakpe oto vehayyayin muttar lezarim. nafal al gabbe hatztzir yakpe oto veyittol kelippa meal hatztzir kede sheyyasir kol hatztzir shebbo taam hashshemen: 
Kedera shebbishshel bah teruma lo yevashshel bah chullin. veim bishshel benoten taam. veim shataf hakkedera bemayim o beyayin hare ze muttar levashshel bah. bishshel bemiktzat hakkeli en tzarich lishtof et kullo ella shotef mekom habbishshul bilvad: 
Teruma gedola uterumat maaser vehachalla vehabbikkurim kullan nikreu teruma. bitrumat maaser neemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 26)</small> "vaharemotem mimmennu terumat Adonai" veomer <small>(Bamidbar 15 20)</small> "kitrumat goren". uvechalla neemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 20)</small> "challa tarimu teruma". veneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "uterumat yadcha". veen lecha davar shettaun havaat makom shello perto befasuk ze chutz min habbikkurim uvahen neemar uterumat yadcha ha lamadta shehen keruin teruma: 
Lefichach din arbatan leinyan achila vedimmua echad hu kullan olin beechad umea umitztarfin ze im ze veim nitmeu yissarfu. vedin terumat maaser shel demay bechol ellu hadderachim kitrumat maaser shel vadday ella sheen lokin al achilatah: 
Kol haochel teruma mevarech birkat oto maachol veachar kach mevarech asher kiddeshanu bikdushshato shel aharon vetzivvanu leechol teruma. vechach kibbalnu verainu otam mevarchin afillu bechallat chutza laaretz sheggam achilat kadshe haggevul kaavoda shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 7)</small> "avodat mattana etten et kehunnatchem": salik hilchot terumot besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 1:
Arbaa shomrim neemru battora ushelosha dinin yesh lahem. veellu hen haarbaa shomrin. shomer chinnam. vehashshoel. venose sachar. vehassocher: 
Veellu hen shelosha dinin shellahen. shomer chinnam shennignav happikkadon mimmennu o avad veen tzarich lomar im neenas happikkadon ones gadol kegon shehayta behema umeta o nishbet hare ze nishba sheshshamar kederech hashshomrin ufatur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 6)</small> "vegunnav mibbet haish" vegomer <small>(Shemot 22 7)</small> "venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim". hashshoel meshallem hakkol ben sheavad davar hashshaul o nignav ben sheero ones gadol mizze kegon shemmeta habbehema hashsheula o nishbera o nishbet shekkach katuv beshoel <small>(Shemot 22 13)</small> "venishbar o met bealav en immo shallem yeshallem". nose sachar o hassocher shenehem din echad yesh lahen im nignav o avad haddavar hassachur o shennatal sachar al shemirato hare ellu meshallemim. veim ero ones gadol mizze kegon shehayta behema umeta o nishbera o nishbet o nitrefa hare ellu nishbain shenneensa ufeturin shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 9)</small> "umet o nishbar o nishba en roe" <small>(Shemot 22 10)</small> "shevuat Adonai" vegomer uchetiv <small>(Shemot 22 11)</small> "im ganov yigganev meimmo yeshallem livalav" vegomer. nimtzeta omer shomer chinnam nishba al hakkol. vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol chutz min hammeta bishat melacha kemo sheyyitbaer. nose sachar vehassocher meshallemin et haaveda veet haggeneva venishbain al hoonasin haggedolim kegon shevura ushevuya umeta uterefa. o sheavad haddavar bisfina shettava bayyam o nilkach belistim mezuyyan vechol kayyotze beellu mishshear onasin haggedolim: 
Hammafkid etzel chavero ben bechinnam ben besachar o hishilo o hiskiro im shaal hashshomer et habbealim im haddavar shellahen o secharan hare hashshomer patur mikkelum. afillu pasha baddavar sheshshamar veavad mechamat happeshia hare ze patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 14)</small> "im bealav immo lo yeshallem im sachir hu ba bischaro". bamme devarim amurim kesheshshaal habbealim o secharan beet shennatal hachefetz af al pi sheen habbealim sham immo beet haggeneva vehaaveda o beet shenneenas. aval natal hachefetz venaasa alav shomer techilla veachar kach sachar habbealim o shealan af al pi shehayu habbealim omdin sham beet shenneenas haddavar hashshamur hare ze meshallem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 13)</small> "bealav en immo shallem yeshallem" mippi hashshemua lamdu haya immo bishat hasheala af al pi sheeno beet haggeneva vehammita patur lo haya immo bishat hasheala af al pi shehaya immo beet hammita o hashsheviyya chayyav. vehu haddin lishar hashshomrim shekkullan bivalim peturin afillu peshia bivalim patur: 
Kol shomer sheppasha bitchillato af al pi shenneenas besofo chayyav kemo sheyyitbaer. veen hashshoel rashshay lehasheil afillu shaal sefer tora shekkol shekkore bo ose mitzva lo yashilennu leacher. vechen en hassocher rashshay lehasekir afillu hiskiro sefer tora lo yaskirennu leacher shehare ze omer lo en retzoni sheyyihye pikdoni beyad acher. avar hashshomer umasar lashshomer hashsheni im yesh edim sheshshemarah hashshomer hashsheni kederech hashshomrin veneenas patur hashshomer harishon shehare yesh edim shenneenas. veim en sham edim chayyav hashshomer harishon leshallem labbealim mippene shemmasar leshomer acher veyaase hu din im hashshomer hashsheni. afillu haya harishon shomer chinnam umasar leshomer sachar chayyav shehare yesh levaal hachefetz lomar lo atta neeman etzli lehishshava veze eno neeman. lefichach im haya derech habbealim lehafekid tamid davar ze etzel hashshomer hashsheni hare ze hashshomer harishon patur milleshallem shehare hu omer labbealim ze haddavar shehifkadtem etzli o hishaltem emesh heyitem mafkidin oto etzel ze shehifkadti ani etzlo. vehu shello yemaet shemirato. ketzad yemaet shemirato. kegon shehaya mufkad etzlo besachar vehifkido etzel oto hashsheni bechinnam o shehaya shaul etzlo vehifkido etzel oto hashsheni besachar hoil umiet shemirato poshea hu umeshallem. af al pi sheshshaal o shessachar babbealim hare hu hotzi haddavar hashshamur miyyado leyad shomer acher: 
Veim hevi hashshomer hashsheni haraya sheyyippater bah shomer rishon kedin shemirato hare ze patur. ketzad. shomer sachar shennatan habbehema hashshemura etzlo leshomer chinnam im hevi hashshomer hashsheni edim shemmeta habbehema kedarkah hare hashshomer harishon patur. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shomer shemmasar leshomer acher vehosif bishmirato umeta hahanaa labbealim. ketzad. hassocher para mechavero vehishilah leacher umeta kedarkah beyad hashshoel hoil vehashshoel chayyav bakkol yachziru deme happara labbealim sheen ze hassocher ose sechora befarato shel chavero. vechen kol kayyotze baze. haya beyado pikkadon ushelacho beyad acher livalav hoil vehashshomer harishon chayyav beacharayuto ad sheyyaggia leyad habbealim im ba lachzor ulehachzir happikkadon miyyad hashshomer hashsheni machzir. veim huchzak hashshomer harishon kafran eno yachol lehachezir happikkadon miyyad hashshomer hashsheni af al pi sheadayin happikkadon beacharayuto shel rishon:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 2:
Shelosha dinin haamurin battora bearbaa hashshomrin enan ella bemittaltelin shel yisrael veshel hedyot shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 6)</small> "kesef o chelim" <small>(Shemot 22 9)</small> "vechol behema" yatzu karkaot veyatzu haavadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot veyatzu hashshetarot sheen gufan mamon veyatzu hekdeshot shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 6)</small> "ki yitten ish el reehu" veyatzu nichse akkum. mikkan amru chachamim haavadim vehashshetarot vehakkarkaot vehahekdeshot shomer chinnam shellahen eno nishba. venose sachar o socher eno meshallem. veim kanu miyyado chayyav beacharayutan: 
Vetikkenu chachamim shennishbain al hahekdeshot shevuat hashshomrin keen shel tora kede shello yezalzelu bahekdeshot: 
Yerae li sheim pasha hashshomer baavadim vechayyotze bahen chayyav leshallem. sheeno patur baavadim vekarkaot ushetarot ella middin geneva vaaveda umeta vechayyotze bahen. sheim haya shomer chinnam al mittaltelin venignevu o avdu yishshava uvaavadim vekarkaot ushetarot patur mishshevua. vechen im haya shomer sachar shemmeshallem geneva vaaveda bemittaltelin patur milleshallem beellu. aval im pasha bah chayyav leshallem shekkol happoshea mazzik hu. veen hefresh ben din hammazzik karka ledin hammazzik mittaltelin. vedin emet hu ze lammevinim vechen rauy ladun. vechen horu rabbotay shehammoser karmo leshomer ben baarisut ben bishmirut chinnam vehitna immo sheyyachpor o yizmor o yeabbek mishshello ufasha velo asa chayyav kemi shehifsid bayyadayim. vechen kol kayyotze baze shehifsid bayyadayim chayyav al kol panim: 
Hammoser lachavero davar hamechubbar lakkarka lishmor afillu hayu anavim haomdot lehibbatzer hare hen kekarka bedin hashshomrin: 
Hifkid hekdesh veachar kach padahu vahare hu chullin beet shennetalo miyyad hashshomer. o shehishilo chullin veachar kach hikdish vehu beyad hashshoel. vechen akkum shehifkid veachar kach nitgayyer. kol ellu en bahen kol dine hashshomrin ad shettihye techillatan vesofan nichse hedyot venichse yisrael: 
Echad haish veechad haishsha bedin hashshomrin ben shehaya haddavar hashshamur shel ishsha o shehaya beyad haishsha: 
Katan shehifkid beyad gadol o hishilo hare ze haggadol nishba shevuat hashshomrim lakkatan. horu rabbotay sheen ze nishba betaanat hakkatan kede shennomar en nishbain al taanat katan shekkol hashshomrin shevuatan shevuat shemma hi: 
Kederech shettikkenu chachamim meshicha belakochot kach tikkenu meshicha beshomrin. haomer lachavero shemor li ze veamar lo hannach lefanay hare ze shomer chinnam. amar lo hannach lefanecha o hannach setam o sheamar lo hare habbayit lefanecha eno lo shomer chinnam velo shomer sachar veeno chayyav shevua kelal aval macharim al mi shellakach happikkadon shello velo yachaziro livalav. vechen kol kayyotze baze. echad hammafkid o hammashil o hammaskir et chavero beedim o shello beedim din echad yesh lahen kevan shehoda ze mippi atzmo sheshshamar lo o sheshshaal mimmennu hare ze nishba shevuat hashshomrin sheen omrim miggo lefatro mishshevua ella lefatro milleshallem. afillu haya haddavar hashshaul o hammufkad o hammuskar sheve peruta hare ze hashshomer nishba alav. veen echad min hashshomrim tzarich lehodaya bemiktzat: 
Matne shomer chinnam lihyot patur mishshevua vehashshoel lihyot patur milleshallem. vechen matne baal happikkadon al shomer chinnam o nose sachar vesocher lihyot chayyavin bakkol keshoel. shekkol tenay bemamon o bishvuot shel mamon kayyam veen tzarich kinyan velo edim: 
Taan ze shehaya sham tenay vehashshomer omer lo haya sham tenay nishba hashshomer shevuat hashshomrin umegalgel bah shello haya sham tenay: 
Taan shehifkid etzlo veze omer lo amarti ella hannach lefanecha velo naaseti lo shomer nishba hesset shello kibbelo ella bederech zo vecholel bishvuato shello shalach bo yad velo ibbedo bayyadayim velo bigram sheggaram lo sheyyihye chayyav leshallem: 
Ze omer hishalticha o hiskarticha o hifkadticha vehalla omer lo hayu devarim meolam. o sheamar ken haya aval hechezarti lecha venistalleka hashshemira velo nishara benenu tevia. hare hannitba nishba shevuat hesset veniftar. bamme devarim amurim keshello haya sham shetar. aval im hifkid o hiskir o hishil bishtar veamar lo hechzarti lecha hare hashshomer nishba binkitat chefetz mittoch sheyyachol lomar shomer chinnam shennignav o avad vehashshoel meta bishat melacha neeman lomar hechzarti. ucheshem sheim taan shenneenas nishba min hattora binkitat chefetz kach im taan hechezarti yishshava keen shel tora hoil veyesh sham shetar beyad hattovea. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hashshomer yachol liton velomar neensu velo natzrich oto lehavi reaya al taanato. aval im haya chayyav lehavi reaya al taanato kemo sheyyitbaer eno neeman lomar hechzarti ella yishshava baal hashshetar binkitat chefetz shello hechzir lo vishallem. en lecha mi shennishba mittoch sheyyachol lomar kach vechach veyishshava binkitat chefetz ella ze hashshomer bilvad sheyyesh alav shetar aval shear kol hannishbain baddin mittoch sheyyachol lomar enan nishbain ella hesset:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 3: Shomer shettaan shenneenas ones gadol kegon shevura umeta. im neenas bemakom shehaedim metzuyin sham matzrichin oto reaya al taanato shenneenas veyippater af mishshevuat shomrim veim lo hevi reaya yeshallem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 9)</small> "en roe" <small>(Shemot 22 10)</small> "shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem" ha bemakom sheefshar lehavi reaya en sham shevua ella o yavi reaya o yeshallem. aval im taan shenneenas bemakom sheen haedim metzuyin sham en matzrichin oto reaya ella yishshava shenneenas veyippater. veim hevi edim shello pasha bah niftar af min hashshevua. maase beechad shehevi chavit shel yayin besachar ushevarah bashshuk shel mechoza uvau lifne chachamim veamru shuk ze shettaanta shennishbera bo chavit bene adam metzuyin sham o tavi reaya shello pashata ella nitkalta venafalta o teshallem dameha. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hammaavir chavit mimmakom lemakom besachar venishbera din tora hu sheyyeshallem sheen ze ones gadol vahare hashshevira kigneva vaaveda shehu chayyav bahen. aval tikkenu chachamim sheyyihye chayyav shevua shello pasha bah sheim atta omer yeshallem en lecha adam sheyyaavir chavit lachavero lefichach asu bo shevirat hechavit kemitat habbehema usheviratah. veod tikkenu bedavar ze sheim nasu otah shenayim bemot venishbera meshallemin chatzi dameha hoil umassoy ze gadol legabbe echad vekal legabbe shenayim hare hu keones veeno ones umeshallemin mechetza im yesh edim shello pashu bah. nishbera bemakom sheen haedim metzuyin nishbain shello shevaruha bifshia umeshallemin chatzi dameha. shehare lo haya lechol echad lehaavir ella massoy sheyyachol lehaaviro bifne atzmo. mikkan atta lamed shehaechad sheheevir chavit gedola sheen derech kol hassabbalim lehaavirah shehu poshea veim nishbera beyado meshallem hakkol:

Hassabbal sheshshavar chavit shel yayin lechenvani venitchayyev leshallem vahare hi shava beyom hashshuk arbaa uvishar hayyamim shelosha im hechziro beyom hashshuk chayyavin lehachezir chavit shel yayin o yeshallemu lo arbaa vehu shello haya lo yayin limkor beyom hashshuk aval im haya lo yayin machazirin lo shelosha. hechziru lo bishar hayyamim machazirin lo shelosha umenakkin lo bechol zeman torach shehaya toreach bimchiratah ufegam hannekev shehaya nokev hechavit vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Roe shebbau zeevim vetarfu mimmennu im haya zeev echad en ze ones afillu bishat mishlachat zeevim. veim hayu shene zeevim hare ze ones. shene kelavim enan ones afillu bau mishshete ruchot. hayu yeter al shenayim hare ze ones. listim mezuyyan hare hu ones vaafillu haya haroe mezuyyan uva lo listim acher mezuyyan hare ze ones sheen haroe moser nafsho kelistim. haari vehaddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash hare ellu onasin. ematay bizman shebbau mealehen. aval im holicham limkom gedude chayyot velistim en ellu onasin vechayyav leshallem:

Roe shemmatza gannav vehitchil lehitgarot bo uleharoto sheeno choshesh mimmennu veamar lo hare anu bemakom peloni vechach vechach roim anachnu vechach vechach kele milchama yesh lanu uva oto hallistim venitztzecho velakach mehen hare haroe chayyav sheechad hammolich et habbehema limkom gedude chayyot velistim o mevi et hallistim behitgaruto limkom habbehema:

Roe shehaya lo lehatztzil hatterefa o hashshevuya beroim acherim uvemaklot velo kara roim acherim velo hevi maklot lehatztzil hare ze chayyav echad shomer chinnam veechad shomer sachar ella sheshshomer chinnam kore roim umevi maklot bechinnam veim lo matza patur aval shomer sachar chayyav liskor haroim vehammaklot ad kede deme habbehema kede lehatztzil vechozer velokeach secharan mibbaal habbayit. veim lo asa chen vehaya lo liskor velo sachar hare ze poshea vechayyav:

Roe shettaan shehitztzalti al yede roim besachar nishba venotel ma shettaan sheeno yachol liton ella ad kede demehen veyachol haya lomar nitrefa veyishshava binkitat chefetz kedin kol hannishbain venotlin:

Roe shehinniach edro uva lair ben beet shedderech haroim lehikkanes uven beet sheen derech haroim lehikkanes uvau zeevim uterafo ari vedaras en omrim illu haya sham haya matztzil ella omdin oto im yachol lehatztzil al yede roim umaklot chayyav veim lav patur veim en haddavar yadua chayyav leshallem:

Meta habbehema kedarkah hare ze ones veharoe patur. sigfah umeta eno ones. tekafattu vealta lerashe tzukin utekafattu venafla hare ze ones. heelah lerashe tzukin o shealta meeleha vehu yachol lemanah velo menaah af al pi shettekafattu venafla umeta o nishbera chayyav shekkol shettechillato bifshia vesofo beones chayyav. vechen roe sheheevir habbehemot al haggesher vedachafa achat mehen lachavertah venafla leshibbolet hannahar hare ze chayyav shehaya lo lehaaviran achat achat sheen hashshomer notel sachar ella lishmor shemira meella vehoil ufasha battechilla veheeviran keechad af al pi shenneenas bassof beet hannefila hare hu chayyav:

Pasha bah veyatza laagam umeta sham kedarkah patur sheen yetziatah garma lah shettavo lide ones ze hoil uchedarkah meta ma li bevet shomer ma li baagam. aval im genavah gannav mehaagam umeta kedarkah bevet haggannav hare hashshomer chayyav af al pi shehu shomer chinnam sheafillu lo meta hare hi aveda beyad haggannav vitziatah garma lah lehigganev. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 4:
Hasocher et hachamor leholichah bahar veholichah babbika im huchleka patur af al pi sheavar al daat habbealim. veim huchamma chayyav. secharah leholichah babbika veholichah bahar im huchleka chayyav shehachalakut yeter bahar min habbika. veim huchamma patur shechamimut babbika yeter min hahar mippene haruach shemmenashshevet berosh heharim. veim huchamma mechamat hammaala chayyav vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen hassocher et happara lachrosh bahar vecharash babbika venishbar hakkankan vehu hakkeli shechoresh bo hare hassocher patur vedin baal happara im haummanin shecharshu. vechen im lo shinna al daat habbealim venishbar hakkankan din baal happara im haummanin. secharah lachrosh babbika vecharash bahar venishbar hakkankan hassocher chayyav vedino shel socher im haummanim: 
Umahu din haummanin sheshshavru beet charisha shemmeshallemin. mi meshallem ze haochez et hakkeli beet hacharisha. veim hayta hassade maalot maalot shenehem chayyavim bidme hakkankan. hammanhig otah bemalmad vehaochez et hakkeli: 
Secharah ladush bekitnit vedash bitvua vehuchleka patur bitvua vedash bekitnit chayyav shehakkitnit machleket. maase beechad shehiskir chamor lachavero veamar lo lo telech bo bederech nahar pekod shehammayim metzuyin sham ella bederech neresh sheen bah mayim. halach bederech nahar pekod umet hachamor velo hayu sham edim shemmeidim bee ze derech halach ella hu meatzmo amar benahar pekod halachti velo hayu sham mayim umechamat atzmo met veamru chachamim hoil veyesh edim shehammayim benahar pekod metzuyin chayyav leshallem shehare shinna al daat habbealim veen omrim ma li leshakker bimkom edim: 
Hassocher et habbehema lehavi aleha matayim litrin shel chittim vehevi matayim litrin shel seorim umeta chayyav mippene shehannefach kashe lemassooy vehasseorin yesh lahen nefach. vechen im secharah lehavi tevua vehevi bemishkalah teven. aval im secharah lehavi aleha seorim vehevi bemishkalan chittim umeta patur. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Sachar et habbehema lirkov aleha ish lo yarkiv aleha ishsha. secharah lirkov aleha ishsha markiv aleha ish. umarkiv aleha kol ishsha ben ketanna ben gedola vaafillu meebberet shehi menika: 
Hassocher et habbehema laset aleha mishkal yadua vehosif al massao im hosif chelek mishsheloshim al hashshiur sheppasak immo umeta chayyav pachot mikkan patur aval noten hu sechar hattosefet. sachar setam eno nose ella bemishkal hayyadua bammedina leotah behema. veim hosif chelek mishsheloshim kegon sheddarkah laset sheloshim vetaan aleha sheloshim veechad umeta o nishbera chayyav. vechen sefina shehosif bah echad mishsheloshim al massaah vetava chayyav leshallem dameha: 
Hakkattaf shehosif al massao kav echad huzzak bemassa ze chayyav binzakav. sheaf al pi shehu ben daat vahare hu margish bechoved hammassa yaale al libbo shemma mechamat chalyo hu ze hakkoved: 
Hassocher et hachamor lirkov aleha yesh lo lehanniach aleha kesuto velagino umezonotav shel oto hadderech lefi sheen derech hassocher lachzor bechol malon umalon liknot mezonot. yeter al ze hare meakkev alav baal hachamor. vechen yesh levaal hachamor lehanniach aleha seorim veteven umezonot shel oto hayyom yeter al ze hassocher meakkev mippene sheefshar lo liknot bechol malon umalon. lefichach im en sham meayin yikne manniach alav mezonotav umezonot behemto shel kol otah hadderech. vechol ellu haddevarim besocher setam uvemakom sheen minhag yadua. aval bemakom sheyyesh minhag hakkol lefi hamminhag:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 5: Hassocher et habbehema vechalta o nishtottet o nilkecha laavodat hammelech af al pi sheen sofah lachzor im nilkecha derech halicha hare hammaskir omer lassocher hare shellecha lefanecha vechayyav litten lo secharo mishshalem. bamme devarim amurim beshessecharah laset aleha massoy sheefshar lehashelicho belo hakepada aval im secharah lirkov aleha o laset aleha kele zechuchit vechayyotze bahen chayyav lehaamid lo chamor acher im sachar mimmennu chamor veim lo heemid yachzir hassachar veyachshov immo al sachar kamma shehalach bah:

Meta habbehema o nishbera ben shessecharah laset ben shessecharah lirkov im amar lo chamor setam ani maskir lecha chayyav lehaamid lo chamor acher mikkol makom. veim lo heemid yesh lassocher limkor habbehema velikkach bah behema acheret o socher behema bedameha im en bedameha likkach ad sheyyaggia lemakom sheppasak bo. amar lo chamor ze ani socher lecha im secharah lirkov aleha o lichle zechuchit umeta bachatzi hadderech im yesh bedameha likkach behema acheret yikkach veim en bedameha likkach socher afillu bidme kullah ad sheyyaggia lammakom sheppasak immo. veim en bedameha lo likkach velo liskor noten lo secharo shel chatzi hadderech veen lo alav ella taromet. secharah lemassa hoil veamar lo chamor ze umet bachatzi hadderech eno chayyav lehaamid lo acher ella noten lo secharo shel chatzi hadderech umanniach lo nivlato:

Hassocher et hassefina vtava lo bachatzi hadderech. im amar lo sefina zo ani maskir lecha usecharah hassocher leholich bah yayin setam af al pi shennatan lo hassachar yachzir kol hassachar shehare ze omer lo have li hassefina atzmah shessacharti shehakepada gedola yesh bisfina zo vaani avi yayin mikkol makom veolich bah. amar lo sefina setam ani maskir lecha usecharah hassocher leholich bah yayin ze af al pi shello natan lo min hassachar kelum chayyav litten kol hassachar. shehare omer lo have li hayyayin atzmo vaani avi lecha sefina mikkol makom veolicho. aval tzarich lenakkot kede hattorach shel chatzi hadderech sheeno dome hametappel beholachat hassefina leyoshev uvatel. amar lo sefina zo ani maskir vesachar hassocher leholich bah yayin ze im natan hassachar eno yachol lehacheziro veim lo natan lo yitten sheen ze yachol lehavi hassefina atzmah velo ze yachol lehavi yayin atzmo. sachar sefina setam leyayin setam hare ellu cholkin hassachar:

Hassocher et hassefina ufarka bachatzi hadderech noten lo sechar kol hadderech veim matza hassocher mi sheyyaskir otah lo ad hammakom sheppasak socher veyesh levaal hassefina alav taromet. vechen im machar kol hassechora shebbassefina leish acher bachatzi hadderech veyarad veala hallokeach notel sechar chatzi hadderech min harishon usechar hachetzi mizze haacharon veyesh levaal hassefina alav taromet sheggaram lo lisbol daat ish acher sheadayin lo hurgal bo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mikkan ani omer shehammaskir bayit lachavero ad zeman katzuv veratza hassocher lehasekir habbayit leacher ad sof zemanno maskir laacherim im yesh bene bayit keminyan bene beto. aval im hayu arbaa lo yiskor lachamishsha. shello amru chachamim en hassocher rashshay lehasekir ella mittaltelin shehare omer lo en retzoni sheyyehe pikdoni beyad acher aval bekarka o bisfina shehare balah immah en omer ken. vechen ani omer im amar lo baal habbayit lassocher lamma titrach vetaskir beti laacherim im lo tirtze laamod bo tze hannicho veatta patur missechirato eno yachol lehasekiro leacher shezze beal timna tov mibbealav ad sheatta maskiro leacher tanniach laze beto. veyesh mi shehora sheeno yachol lehasekiro leacher kelal veyitten secharo ad sof zemanno velo yerae li sheddin ze emet:

Bayit ze ani maskir lecha veachar shehiskiro nafal eno chayyav livnoto ella mechashshev al ma shennishtammesh bo umachazir lo shear hassechirut. aval im setaro chayyav lehaamid lo bayit acher o yaskir lo kemoto. vechen im chazar achar shehiskiro laze vehiskiro o mecharo leakkum o annas shehifkia sechirut harishon hare ze chayyav lehasekir lo bayit acher kemoto. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hiskir lo bayit setam veachar shennatan lo bayit nafal chayyav livnoto o yitten lo bayit acher. veim haya katan min habbayit shennafal en hassocher yachol leakkev alav. vehu sheyyihye karuy bayit shello hiskir ella bayit setam. aval im amar lo bayit kaze ani maskir lecha chayyav lehaamid lo bayit kemiddat arko umiddat rachbo shel bayit ze sheherahu. veeno yachol lomar lo lo haya inyan devaray ella sheyyihye karov lannahar o lashshuk o lammerchatz kaze ella chayyav lehaamid lo bayit kemiddato uchetzurato lefichach im haya katan lo yaasennu gadol gadol lo yaasennu katan echad lo yaasennu shenayim shenayim lo yaasennu echad. velo yifchot min hachallonot shehayu bo velo yosif alehen ella middaat shenehem:

Hammaskir aliyya setam chayyav lehaamid lo aliyya. amar lo aliyya zo sheal gabbe bayit ze ani maskir lecha hare shibed bayit laaliyya lefichach im nifchata haaliyya bearbaa tefachim o yeter chayyav hammaskir letakken veim lo tikken hare hassocher yored vedar babbayit im baal habbayit ad sheyyetakken. hayu shete aliyyot zo al gabbe zo venifchata haelyona dar battachtona. nifchata hattachtona hare ze safek im yadur baelyona o babbayit lefichach lo yadur veim dar en motziin oto mishsham. maase beechad sheamar lachavero dallit zo sheal gabbe happarsek hazze ani maskir lecha veneekar ilan happarsek mimmekomo uva maase lifne chachamim veamru lo chayyav atta lehaamid happarsek kol zeman shehaddallit kayyemet. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 6:
Hammaskir bayit lachavero bevira gedola mishtammesh bezizeha uvichtaleha ad arba ammot uvetarbatz shel chatzer uvarchava sheachore habbattim. umakom shennahagu lehishtammesh boovi hakketalim mishtammesh boovi hakketalim. uvechol ellu haddevarim holchin achar minhag hammedina vehashshemot hayeduin lahem kederech sheamarnu beinyan mikkach umimkar: 
Hammaskir chatzero setam lo hiskir harefet shebbah: 
Hammaskir bayit lachavero chayyav lehaamid lo delatot veliftoach lo hachallonot shennitkalkelu ulechazzek et hattikra velismoch et hakkora shennishbera velaasot neger umanul vechol kayyotze beellu middevarim shehen maase umman vehem ikkar gadol bishivat habbattim vehachatzerot. hassocher chayyav laasot maake umezuza uletakken mekom hammezuza mishshello. vechen im ratza laasot sullam o marzev o lehatiach gaggo hare ze ose mishshel atzmo: 
Hammaskir aliyya lachavero venifchata bearbaa o yeter chayyav letakken hattikra vehammaaziva shealeha shehammaaziva chizzuk hattikra hi: 
Hazzevel shebbechatzer hare hu shel socher lefichach hu metappel bo lehotzio veim yesh sham minhag holchin acher hamminhag. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu habbehemot sheasu hazzevel shel socher aval im habbehemot shel acherim hazzevel shel baal hechatzer shechatzero shel adam kona shello middato af al pi shehi sechura beyad acherim: 
Hammaskir bayit o chatzer o merchatz o chanut o shear hammekomot ad zeman katzuv hare ze kofehu latzet besof zemanno veeno mamtin lo afillu shaa achat. sachar lo bayit setam lelina en pachot miyyom echad. lishvita en pachot mishshene yamim. lenissuin en pachot mishsheloshim yom: 
Hammaskir bayit lachavero setam eno yachol lehotzio ad sheyyodio sheloshim yom mikkodem kede levakkesh makom velo yihye mushlach badderech ulesof hashsheloshim yetze. bamme devarim amurim bimot hachamma aval bimot haggeshamim eno yachol lehotzio min hechag vead happesach. kava lo sheloshim lifne hechag im nishar min hashsheloshim yom afillu yom echad leachar hechag eno yachol lehotzio ad motzae happesach vehu sheyyodio sheloshim yom mikkodem. bamme devarim amurim baayarot aval bakkerakkim echad yemot hachamma veechad yemot haggeshamim tzarich lehodio shenem asar chodesh mikkodem. vechen bachanut ben bakkerakkim ben baayarot tzarich lehodio shenem asar chodesh mikkodem: 
Keshem shehammaskir chayyav lehodio kach hassocher chayyav lehodio mikkodem sheloshim yom baayarot o mikkodem shenem asar chodesh bakkerakkim kede sheyyevakkesh shachen velo yishshaer beto panuy. veim lo hodio eno yachol latzet ella yitten hassachar: 
Af al pi sheen hammaskir yachol lehotzio velo hassocher yachol latzet ad sheyyodio mikkodem. im hukeru habbattim yesh lammaskir lehosif alav velomar lassocher o sechor beshave ad shettimtza o tetze. vechen im huzelu habbattim yesh lassocher lifchot hassachar velomar lammaskir o haseker li keshaar shel atta o hare betcha lefanecha. nafal bet hammaskir shehaya dar bo hare ze yesh lo lehotzi hassocher mibbeto veomer lo eno bedin shettihye atta yoshev beveti ad shettimtza makom vaani mushlach bederech sheen atta baal zechut bevayit ze yoter mimmenni: 
Natan habbayit livno lissa bo ishsha im haya yodea shebbeno naasa chatan bizman peloni vehaya efshar lo lehodio mikkodem velo hodio eno yachol lehotzio. veim achshav nizdammena lo ishsha vahare hu nosah miyyad hare ze yesh lo lehotzio sheeno bedin sheyyihye ze yoshev beveto uven baal habbayit yiskor bayit sheyyaase bo chatunna: 
Machar et habbayit o netano o horisho en hashsheni yachol lehotzio ad sheyyodio mikkodem sheloshim yom o mikkodem shenem asar chodesh. shehare hassocher omer lo en kochacha yeter mikkoach ze shezzachita bevayit ze mechamato:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 7:
Keshem shemmatne adam kol tenay sheyyirtze bemikkach umimkar kach matne bischirut shehassechirut mechira lizman katzuv hi vechol shemmimkaro binchasav mimkar socher sechiruto sechirut. vechol sheen lo limkor kach en lo liskor ella im ken yesh lo perot bilvad beotah hakkarka hare ze socher veeno mocher: 
Hammaskir bayit lachavero leshana venitabbera hashshana nitabbera lassocher. hiskir lechodashim nitabbera lammaskir. hizkir lo chodashim veshana ben sheamar lo dinar lechodesh shenem asar dinar beshana. ben sheamar lo shenem asar dinar leshana dinar bechol chodesh. hare chodesh haibbur shel maskir shehakkarka bechezkat bealim veen motziin davar miyyad baal hakkarka ella biraya berura. vechen baal habbayit sheamar lizman ze hiskarti lecha vehassocher omer lo sacharti ella setam o lizman aroch al hassocher lehavi reaya veim lo hevi baal habbayit nishba hesset umotzio min habbayit: 
Hassocher sheamar natatti sechar habbayit shennitchayyavti bo vehammaskir omer adayin lo natalti ben shehayta bishtar ben shehayta beedim. im tevao betoch sheloshim yom al hassocher lehavi reaya o yitten veyacharim al mi shellakach mimmennu o yiton alav bedamim shennatan techilla taana bifne atzmah veyashbiehu hesset. tevao hammaskir leachar sheloshim yom vaafillu bayyom hashsheloshim al hammaskir lehavi reaya o yishshava hassocher shekkevar natan lo secharo veyippater. vechen im sachar mimmennu uferesh sheyyitten lo hassachar shana beshana utevao betoch hashshana al hassocher lehavi reaya. tevao leachar hashshana vaafillu beyom tisha veesrim beelul al hammaskir lehavi reaya: 
Hammaskir bayit lachavero bishtar leeser shanim veen bo zeman hassocher omer adayin lo avar mizzeman hashshetar ella shana vehammaskir omer kevar avru veshalmu shene hassechirut veshachanta eser shanim. al hassocher lehavi reaya veim lo hevi reaya yishshava hammaskir hesset veyotzio: 
Hassocher pardes o shehaya mashkon beyado leeser shanim veyavesh happardes betoch hazzeman yimmachru etzav veyillakach bahen karka veyochal perotav ad sof zeman sechiruto o zeman hammashkon. veguf hailanot sheyyavshu o niktzetzu shenehen asurin bahen mishshum ribbit hammalve vehallo: 
Shetar hassechirut o shetar hammashkon shekkatuv bah shanim setam. baal happerot omer shalosh uvaal hakkarka omer shetayim vekadam ze hassocher o hammalve veachal happerot hare happerot bechezkat ochlehen ad sheyyavi baal hakkarka reaya. achalah hassocher o hamemashken shalosh shanim vechavash hashshetar veamar lechamesh shanim yesh li perot uvaal hakkarka omer shalosh amru lo have shetarcha veamar avad hassocher neeman sheillu ratza amar lekucha hi beyadi shehare achalah shalosh shanim: 
Mi shehichnis perotav levet chavero shello middato o shehituhu ad shehichnis perotav vehinnicham vehalach yesh levaal habbayit limkor lo meotan happerot kede litten sechar happoalim shemmotziin otan umashlichin otam lashshuk. umiddat chasidut hu sheyyodia levet din veyaskiru mimmiktzat demehen makom mishshum heshshev aveda labbealim af al pi shello asa kahogen: 
Hassocher rechayim mechavero sheyyitchon lo esrim sea bechol chodesh bischaro veheeshir baal harechayim vahare eno tzarich litchon sham im yesh lassocher chittim shetztzarich litchon leatzmo o laacherim kofin oto litten deme techinat esrim sea shezzo middat sedom hi. veim en lo yachol lomar en li damim vahareni tochen lecha kemo shessacharti veim en atta tzarich mechor laacherim. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 8:
Echad hassocher mechavero sade lezarah o kerem leechol perotav bedamim o shessachar mimmennu beferot ketzuvim kegon shessachar mimmennu sade zo beesrim kor beshana vecherem ze beesrim kadde yayin bechol shana shenehen din echad yesh lahen. vehassocher beferot hu hannikra chocher: 
Hamekabbel sade o pardes kede laavod oto ulehotzi alav yetziot veyitten levaal hakkarka shelish hattevuot o revia o ma sheyyatnu benehen vehu hannikra mekabbel. kol davar shehu lisyag haaretz baal hakkarka chayyav bo vechol davar shehu shemira yetera hachocher o hamekabbel chayyav bo. hakkardom shechofrin bo haaretz vehakkelim shennosin bahen heafar vehaddeli vehakkad vechayyotze bahen sheddolin bahen hammayim al baal hakkarka. vachatitat hammekomot shemmekabbetzin bahen hammayim al hachocher o al hamekabbel: 
Hassocher o hamekabbel sade mechavero leshanim muatot lo yizraenna pishtan. secharah o kibbelah sheva shanim zorah shana rishona pishtan veen hashsheviit min hamminyan. secharah o kibbelah shavua echad sheviit min hamminyan: 
Hachocher o hamekabbel sade mechavero vehi bet hashshelachin o bet hailan veyavsha mayan bet hashshelachin velo pasak hannahar haggadol ella efshar lehavi mimmennu bidli. o shenniktzatz hailan shel bet hailanot eno menakke lo mechakkiro. veim makkat medina hi kegon sheyyavash hannahar menakke lo mechakkiro. haya omed betoch hassade veamar lo bet hashshelachin hazze ani maskir lecha bet hailan ze ani maskir yavesh hammayan o niktzatz hailan menakke mechakkiro shehare hu omed betochah velo amar lo hazze ella kemi sheomer kemot shehi atta ani maskir lefichach im lo haya omed betochah veamar lo bet hashshelachin ani maskir lecha o bet hailan veyavesh hammayan o shenniktzatz hailan eno menakke lo mechakkiro: 
Hassocher o hamekabbel sade mechavero vaachalah chagav o nishtaddefa im era davar ze lerov hassadot shel otah hair menakke lo mechakkiro hakkol lefi hahefsed sheero veim lo pashta hammakka berov hassadot eno menakke lo mechakkiro af al pi shennishtaddefu kol hassadot shel baal hakkarka. nishtaddefu kol hassadot shel hassocher o hamekabbel af al pi sheppashta hammakka berov hassadot eno menakke lo mechakkiro sheen ze hahefsed taluy ella bassocher shehare kol sedotav nishtaddefu. hitna alav baal hakkarka sheyyizraenna chittim uzeraah seorim o shello zeraah kelal o shezzeraah velo tzamcha af al pi shebba chagav o shiddafon vehukketa rov hammedina eno menakke lo mechakkiro. vead matay chayyav lehittappel velizroa paam acheret im lo tzamcha kol zeman sherauy lizria beoto makom: 
Hassocher o hamekabbel sade mechavero makom shennahagu liktzor yiktzor veeno rashshay laakor. laakor yaakor veeno rashshay liktzor. ushenehem meakkevin ze al ze. umakom shennahagu lachrosh acharav yachrosh. makom shennahagu lehasekir ilanot al gav karka maskirin veaf al pi shehiskir lo setam befachot min hayyadua. umakom shennahagu shello lehasekir ilanot en lo ilanot af al pi shessachar mimmennu beyeter al hayyadua. hakkol keminhag hammedina: 
Hachocher sade mechavero baasara kor chittim velakta noten lo mittochah. hayu chitteha yafot lo yomar lo hareni lokeach lecha min hashshuk ella noten lo mittochah. chachar mimmennu kerem baasara salle anavim vehikrisu achar shennivtzeru vechen omarim shelaku achar shenniktzeru noten lo mittochan. chacharo baasara kadde yayin vehechmitz chayyav litten lo yayin tov. chacharah mimmennu bemea omarim shel aspasta uzeraah min acher veachar kach charashah uzeraah aspasta velakta o shezzeraah battechilla aspasta vacharashah veachar kach zeraah paam acheret velakta eno noten lo mittochah ella noten lo aspasta tova shehare shinna. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hachocher sade mechavero velo ratza lenakkesh veamar lo ma hefsed yesh lecha hareni noten lecha chakkircha en shomin lo shehare hu omer lo lemachar atta yotze mimmenna vehi maala asavim. vaafillu amar lo baacharona ani choresh otah en shomin lo: 
Hachocher sade mechavero lezarah seorim lo yizraenna chittim mippene shehachittin machchishot et hakkarka yeter mehasseorim. secharah lezarah chittim yizraenna seorim. kitnit lo yizraenna tevua. tevua yizraenna kitnit. uvevavel vechayyotze bah lo yizraenna kitnit mippene shehakkitnit sham machcheshet et haaretz: 
Hamekabbel sade mechavero leshanim muatot en lamkabbel kelum bekorat hashshikma vechayyotze bah velo beshevach hailanot sheyyatzu mealehen bassade. aval mechashshevin lo mekom hailanot keillu haya bahen oto zera shezzara bechol hassade. vehu shetztzamchu hailanot bemakom harauy lizria aval im yatzu bemakom sheeno rauy lizria en mechashshevin lo kelum. veim kibbelah sheva shanim o yeter yesh lo bekorat hashshikma vechayyotze bah. higgia zemanno lehistallek min hassade vehayu sham zeraim sheadayin lo higgiu lehimmacher o shennigmeru velo higgia yom hashshuk lemachran shamin otan venotel mibbaal hakkarka. keshem shecholkin hamekabbel uvaal hakkarka battevua kach cholkin batteven uvakkash. keshem shecholkin bayyayin kach cholkin bazzemorot. aval hakkanim hammaamidim tachat haggefanim im kanu otan beshuttafut hare ellu cholkin bahen veim hen mishshel echad mehen ze shekkana otan hare hen shello. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hamekabbel sade mechavero litta mekabbel alav baal hassade asara borot lisa. yeter al ze megalgelin alav et hakkol: 
Hamekabbel sade mechavero velo asta im yesh bah kede shettotzi satayim yeter al hahotzaa chayyav hamekabbel littafel bah. shekkach kotev levaal hakkarka anna ekum veanir veezra veektzor veeemor veadush veezre veaamid keri lefanecha vetittol et chetzyo o ma sheyyittenu vaani ettol hashshear bischar amali uvema shehotzeti: 
Hamekabbel sade mechavero veachar shezzacha bah hovirah shamin otah kamma hi reuya laasot venoten lo chelko shehaya maggia lo. shekkach kotev levaal hakkarka im ovir velo aavid ashallem bemetava. vehu haddin im hovir miktzatah. umippene ma nitchayyev leshallem mippene shello pasak al atzmo davar katzuv kede shennomar hare hi keasmachta ella hitna sheyyeshallem bemetava ulefichach gamar veshibed atzmo. aval im amar im ovir velo aavid etten lecha mea dinarin hare zo asmachta veeno chayyav leshallem ella noten kefi ma sheruya laasot bilvad: 
Hamekabbel sade lezarah shumshemin uzeraah chittim veasta chittim sheshshavin kamma shehi reuya laasot min hashshumshemin en lo alav ella taromet. asta pachot mimma shehi reuya laasot min hashshumshemin meshallem lo hamekabbel kefi ma shehi reuya laasot min hashshumshemin. asta chittim yeter mimma shehi reuya laasot min hashshumshemin cholkin lefi hattenay shebbenehen af al pi shemmistakker baal hakkarka:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 9: Hasocher et happoalim veamar lahem lehashekim ulehaariv makom shennahagu shello lehashekim veshello lehaariv eno yachol lechufan. makom shennahagu lazun yazun. lesappek bigrogarot o bitmarim vechayyotze bahen lefoalim yesappek hakkol keminhag hammedina:
Hassocher et happoel veamar lo keechad vechishnayim mibbene hair roin happachut shebbassechirut vehayyater shebbassechirut umeshammenin benehen:

Amar lishlucho tze usechor li poalim bishlosha vehalach usecharan bearbaa im amar lahem hashshaliach secharchem alay noten lahem arbaa venotel mibbaal habbayit shelosha umafsid echad mikkiso. amar lahem secharchem al baal habbayit noten lahem baal habbayit keminhag hammedina. haya bammedina mi shenniskar bishlosha umi shenniskar bearbaa eno noten lahem ella shelosha veyesh lahem taromet al hashshaliach. bamme devarim amurim kesheen melachtan nikkeret aval hayta melachtan nikkeret vahare hi shava arbaa noten lahem baal habbayit arbaa sheillu lo amar lahem shelucho arbaa lo tarchu veasu shave arbaa. amar lo baal habbayit sechor li bearbaa vehalach hashshaliach vesachar bishlosha af al pi shehare melachtan shava arbaa en lahem ella shelosha shehare kibbelu al atzman veyesh lahem taromet al hashshaliach. amar lo baal habbayit bishlosha vehalach hashshaliach veamar lahem bearbaa veamru harenu kema sheamar baal habbayit en datam ella sheyyitten baal habbayit yeter al arbaa lefichach shamin ma sheasu im shava arbaa notlin arbaa mibbaal habbayit veim eno yadua o eno shave en lahem ella shelosha. amar lo baal habbayit bearbaa vehalach hashshaliach veamar lahem bishlosha veamru lo kema sheamar baal habbayit af al pi shemmelachtan shave arbaa en lahem ella shelosha shehare shamu shelosha vekibbelu alehem:

Hassocher et happoalim vehitu et baal habbayit o baal habbayit hita otam en lahem ze al ze ella taromet. bamme devarim amurim beshello halchu. aval halchu hachammarin velo matzu tevua. poalim umatzu sade keshehi lacha. o shessachar lehashekot hassade umetzauha shennitmallea mayim. im bikker baal habbayit melachto mibbaerev umatza shetztzericha poalim en lappoalim kelum ma beyado laasot. veim lo bikker noten lahem secharan kefoel batel sheeno dome habba taun leva rekan veose melacha levattel. bamme devarim amurim beshello hitchilu bimlacha. aval im hitchil happoel bammelacha vechazar bo afillu bachatzi hayyom chozer shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 55)</small> "ki li vene yisrael avadim" velo avadim laavadim. vechetzad din happoel shechazar bo achar shehitchil. shamin lo ma sheasa venotel. veim kabbelan hu shamin lo ma sheatid laasot. ben shehuzelu beet shessecharan ben lo huzelu ben shehuzela melacha achar ken ben lo huzela shamin lo ma sheatid laasot. ketzad. kibbel mimmennu kama liktzor bishte selaim katzar chetzyah vehinniach chetzyah. beged leerog bishte selaim arag chetzyo vehinniach chetzyo. shamin lo ma sheatid laasot. im haya shave shishsha dinarin noten lo shekel o yigmeru et melachtan. veim haya hannishar yafe shenayim dinarin eno noten lahen ella sela shehare lo asu ella chatzi melacha. bamme devarim amurim bedavar sheeno avud aval bedavar haavud kegon pishtano lehaalot min hammishra o shessachar chamor lehavi chalilin lemet o lechalla vechayyotze bahen echad poel veechad kabbelan eno yachol lachzor bo ella im ken neenas kegon shechala o shama shemmet lo met. veim lo neenas vechazar bo socher alehen o matan. ketzad matan. omer lahem sela katzatzti lachem bou utelu shetayim ad sheyyigmeru melachtan velo yitten lahem ella ma sheppasak techilla vaafillu natan lahem hashshetayim machzir mehen hattosefet. ketzad socher alehen. socher poalim acherim vegomrim melachtan shello tovad vechol sheyyosif leellu happoalin haacherim al ma sheppasak larishonim notel min harishonim. ad kamma ad kede secharan shel rishonim. veim haya lahem mamon tachat yado socher lehashelim hammelacha ad arbaim vachamishshim zuz bechol yom lechol poel af al pi shessachar happoel shelosha o arbaa. bamme devarim amurim sheen sham poalim liskor bischaran lehashelim hammelacha aval yesh poalim liskor bischaran veamru lo tze usechor meellu lehashelim melachtecha velo tovad ben socher ben kabbelan en lo alehen ella taromet veshamin lassocher ma sheasa velakkabbelan ma sheatid laasot:
Hassocher et happoel veneechaz laavodat hammelech lo yomar lo hareni lefanecha ella noten lo sechar ma sheasa:

Hassocher et happoel lehashekot et hassade mizze hannahar ufasak hannahar bachatzi hayyom im en darko lehafesik en lahen ella sechar ma sheasu. vechen im darko sheyyafsiku oto bene hair vehifsikuhu bachatzi hayyom en lahen ella sechar ma sheasu shehare yadu happoalim darko shel nahar. veim darko lehafesik meelav noten lahem sechar kol hayyom mippene shehaya lo lehodiam. secharan lehashekot hassade uva hammatar vehishka en lahen ella ma sheasu. ba hannahar vehishka noten lahen kol secharan. min hashshamayim nistayyeu. bamme devarim amurim befoel. aval mi sheppasak im ariso sheim yashke sade zo arba peamim beyom yittol chatzi happerot vechol haarisin shehen mashkin shete peamim enan notlin ella revia happerot uva hammatar velo hutzrach lidlot ulehashkot notel chatzi happerot kemo sheppasak immo shehaaris keshuttaf veeno kefoel:

Hassocher et happoel laasot melacha kol hayyom veshalma hammelacha bachatzi hayyom im yesh lo melacha acheret kemotah o kalla mimmenna ose shear hayyom. veim en lo ma yaase noten lo secharo kefoel batel. veim haya min hachofrim o ovde adama vechayyotze bahen sheddarko litroach harebe veim lo yaase bimlacha yechele noten lo kol secharo:

Hassocher et happoel lehavi lo shelichut mimmakom lemakom vehalach velo matza sham ma yavi noten lo secharo mishshalem. secharo lehavi kanim lakkerem vehalach velo matza velo hevi noten lo secharo mishshalem. secharo lehavi keruv udormaskenin lachole vehalach umetzao shemmet o hivri lo yomar lo tol ma sheheveta bischarcha ella noten lo kol secharo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Hassocher et happoel laasot immo beshello veherahu beshel chavero noten kol secharo vechozer velokeach mechavero ma shennehena bezo hammelacha:

Hassocher et happoel laasot immo beteven vekash vechayyotze bahen veamar lo tol ma sheasita bischarcha en shomin lo. veim mishshekkibbel alav amar lo helach secharcha vaani ettol et shelli en shomin lo:

Metziat happoel leatzmo af al pi sheamar lo ase immi melacha hayyom. veen tzarich lomar im amar lo ador immi hayyom. aval im secharo lilkot metziot kegon shechasar hannahar usecharo lilkot haddagim hannimtzain baagam hare metziato levaal habbayit vaafillu matza kis male dinarin:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 10:
Hammalve et chavero al hammashkon ben shehilvahu maot ben shehilvahu perot ben shemmishkeno bishat halevaato ben shemmishkeno achar shehilvahu hare ze shomer sachar. lefichach im avad hammashkon o nignav chayyav bedamav. veim neenas hammashkon kegon shennilkach belistim mezuyyan vechayyotze bo mishshear onasin yishshava shenneenas vishallem baal hammashkon et chovo ad peruta acharona: 
Kol haomer lachavero shemor li veeshmor lecha hare ze shemira babbealim. amar lo shemor li hayyom veeshmor lecha lemachar. hasheileni hayyom vaani ashilcha lemachar. shemor li hayyom veashilcha lemachar. hasheileni hayyom veeshmor lecha lemachar. kullan naasu shomre sachar ze laze: 
Kol haummanin shomre sachar hen. vechullan sheamru tol et shellecha vehave maot o sheomer lo haumman gemartiv velo lakchu habbealim et hakkeli haumman shomer chinnam. aval im amar haumman have maot vetol shellecha adayin hu nose sachar keshehaya: 
Natan leummanin letakken vekilkelu chayyavin leshallem. ketzad. natan lecheresh shidda teva umigdal likboa bahen masmer ushevaro o shennatan lo et haetzim laasot mehen shidda teva umigdal venishberu achar shennaasu meshallem lo deme shidda teva umigdal. sheen haumman kone beshevach hakkeli. natan tzemer letzabba vehikdichattu yora noten lo deme tzimro. tzevao kaur o netano lo letzavo adom utzevao shachor shachor utzevao adom. natan etzim lecharash laasot mehen kisse nae veasa kisse ra o safsal. im hashshevach yater al hahotzaa noten baal hakkeli et hahotzaa veim hahotzaa yetera al hashshevach noten lo et hashshevach bilvad. amar baal hakkeli eni rotze betakkana zo ella yitten li deme hatztzemer o deme haetzim en shomin lo. vechen im amar haumman he lecha deme tzimrecha o deme etzcha velech en shomin lo sheen haumman kone beshevach keli sheasa: 
Hammolich chittin litchon velo letatan vaasaan subbin o mursan. natan hakkemach lenachtom vaasao pat nefolin. behema letabbach venibbelah. chayyavin leshallem demehen mippene shehen nose sachar. lefichach im haya tabbach mumche veshachat bechinnam patur milleshallem veeno mumche af al pi shehu bechinnam chayyav leshallem. vechen hammare dinar leshulchani veamar lo yafe hu venimtza ra im besachar raahu chayyav leshallem af al pi shehu baki veeno tzarich lehitlammed. veim bechinnam raahu patur vehu sheyyihye baki sheeno tzarich lehitlammed. veim eno baki chayyav leshallem af al pi shehu bechinnam vehu sheyyomar lashshulchani alecha ani somech o shehayu haddevarim marin shehu somech al reiyyato velo yare laacherim. tabbach sheasa bechinnam venibbel vechen shulchani sheamar yafe venimtza ra vechen kol kayyotze baze alehen lehavi reaya shehen mumchin. veim lo heviu reaya meshallemin: 
Makom shennahagu sheyyihye hannotea ilanot notel chatzi hashshevach uvaal hakkarka chatzi venata vehishbiach venata vehifsid mechashshevin lo chatzi hashshevach sheyyesh lo umenakkin mimmennu ma shehifsid venotel hashshear. vaafillu hitna al atzmo sheim hifsid lo yittol kelum hare ze asmachta veen menakkin lo ella ma shehifsid. haya minhagam sheyyittol hannotea mechetza uvaal hakkarka mechetza vechach haya minhagam sheyyittol haaris shelish. im nata hannotea vehishbiach veratza lehistallek shennimtza baal hakkarka tzarich lehorid lah aris hare baal hakkarka morid aris veyittol baal hakkarka chetzyo velo yafsid baal hakkarka kelum veyittol haaris shelish vehashshetut hannishar shel notea shehare sillek atzmo birtzono: 
Hannotea ilanot livne hammedina shehifsid. vechen tabbach shel bene hair shennibbel habbehemot. vehammakkiz dam shechaval. vehassofer shettaa bishtarot. umelammed tinokot sheppasha betinokot velo limmed o limmed betaut. vechol kayyotze beellu haummanim shei efshar sheyyachziru hahefsed shehifsidu. mesallekin otan belo hateraa shehen kemutrin veomdin ad sheyyishtaddelu bimlachtan hoil veheemidu otan hatztzibbur alehem:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 11: Mitzvat ase litten sechar hassachir bizmanno shonneemar <small>(Devarim 24 15)</small> "beyomo titten secharo" vegomer. veim icharo leachar zemanno over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 15)</small> "velo tavo alav hashshemesh". veen lokin alav shehare hu chayyav leshallem. echad sechar haadam veechad sechar habbehema veechad sechar hakkelim chayyav litten bizmanno veim icher leachar zeman over belo taase. veger toshav yesh bo mishshum beyomo titten secharo veim icharo eno over belo taase:

Kol hakkovesh sechar sachir keillu natal nafsho mimmennu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 15)</small> "veelav hu nosho et nafsho". veover bearba azharot vaase. over mishshum bal <small>(Vayikra 19 13)</small> "taashok" umishshum bal <small>(Vayikra 19 13)</small> "tigzl" umishshum lo talin peullat sachir umishshum <small>(Devarim 24 15)</small> "lo tavo alav hashshemesh" umishshum <small>(Devarim 24 15)</small> "beyomo titten secharo". e zehu zemanno sechir yom gove kol hallayla vealav neemar <small>(Vayikra 19 13)</small> "lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker". usechir layla gove kol hayyom vealav neemar beyomo titten secharo. usechir shaot shel yom gove kol hayyom usechir shaot shel layla gove kol hallayla. sechir shabbat sechir chodesh sechir shana sechir shavua yatza bayyom gove kol hayyom yatza ballayla gove kol (oto) hallayla:

Natan tallito leumman ugemarah vehodio afillu icharo asara yamim kol zeman shehakkeli beyad haumman eno over. netanah bachatzi hayyom kevan sheshshaka alav chamma over mishshum bal <small>(Vayikra 19 13)</small> "talin" shehakkabbelanut kischirut hi vechayyav litten lo bizmanno:

Haomer lishlucho tze usechor li poalim. amar lahem secharchem al baal habbayit shenehem enan ovrin mishshum bal <small>(Vayikra 19 13)</small> "talin" ze lefi shello secharan veze lefi sheen peullatan etzlo. veim lo amar lahem secharchem al baal habbayit hashshaliach over. en hassocher over ella bizman shettevao hassachir velo natan lo aval im lo tevao o shettevao velo haya lo ma yitten lo o shehimchahu etzel acher vekibbel hare ze patur:

Hammashhe sechar sachir ad achar zemanno af al pi shekkevar avar baase velo taase hare ze chayyav litten miyyad. vechol et sheyyishhe over al lav shel divrehem shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 3 28)</small> "al tomar lereacha lech vashuv":

Kol sachir shessecharo beedim utevao bizmanno veamar baal habbayit natatti lecha secharcha vehassachir omer lo natalti kelum tikkenu chachamim sheyyishshava hassachir binkitat chefetz veyittol kedin kol nishba venotel mippene shebbaal habbayit tarud befoalav veze hassachir nose nafsho laze. afillu haya hassachir katan hassachir nishba venotel. secharo shello beedim mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo hayu devarim meolam velo secharticha neeman lomar secharticha venatatti lecha secharcha veyishshava baal habbayit hesset shennatan o shevuat hattora im hoda bemiktzat kishar hatteanot. haya lo ed echad shessecharo eno moil lo kelum vechen im tevao achar zemanno af al pi shessecharo beedim hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. veim lo hevi reaya yishshava baal habbayit hesset. hevi reaya shettevao kol zemanno hare ze nishba venotel kol oto hayyom shel tevia. ketzad. haya ose immo beyom sheni ad haerev zemanno kol lel shelishi uvayyom hashshelishi eno nishba venotel. veim hevi edim shehaya tovo kol lel shelishi hare ze nishba venotel kol yom shelishi. aval millel revii vahala hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vechen im hevi edim shehaya tovo veholech ad yom chamishi hare ze nishba venotel kol yom chamishi:

Baal habbayit omer shetayim katzatzti lecha vehassachir omer shalosh katzatzta li lo tikkenu chachamim sheyyishshava hassachir kan ella hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. veim lo hevi reaya af al pi shekkevar natan lo shetayim o sheamar lo helach hare baal habbayit nishba binkitat chefetz vedavar ze takkanat chachamim hu kede shello yelech hassachir befache nefesh. bamme devarim amurim beshessecharo beedim velo yadu kamma pasak lo utevao bizmanno aval im secharo shello beedim o shettevao achar zemanno yishshava baal habbayit hesset shello katzatz lo ella ma shekkevar natan lo o shello nishar lo etzlo ella ze sheamar lo helach kedin kol hatteanot:

Hannoten tallito leumman umman omer shenayim katzatzta li vehalla omer lo katzatzti ella echad kol zeman shehattallit beyad haumman im yachol liton shehi lekucha beyado hare haumman nishba binkitat chefetz venotel. veyachol liton shehi bischaro ad kede dameha. veim yatzat tallit mittachat yado o sheen lo bah chazaka veeno yachol liton shehi lekucha beyado hammotzi mechavero alav haraya veim lo hevi reaya yishshava baal hattallit hesset o shevuat hattora im hoda bemiktzat kedin kol hatteanot. sheen ze kedin hassachir:

Sachir habba lehishshava en machamirin alav veen megalgelin alav kelal ella nishba shello natal veyittol. ulechol hannishbain en mekillin chutz min hassachir shemmekillin alav ufotchin lo techilla veomrim lo al tetzaer atzmecha hishshava vetol. afillu haya secharo peruta achat uvaal habbayit omer netattiha lo yittol ella bishvua. vechen kol hannishba venotel afillu lo yiton ella peruta achat lo yittol otah ella bishvua keen shel tora:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 12:
Happoalim shehen osin bedavar sheggiddulo min haaretz vaadayin lo nigmera melachto ben betalush ben bimchubbar veyihyu maasehen gemirat hammelacha hare al baal habbayit mitzva sheyyanniach otan leechol mimma shehen osin bo. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 25)</small> "ki tavo becherem reecha" vegomer vechatuv <small>(Devarim 23 26)</small> "ki tavo bekamat reecha". mippi hashshemua lamdu sheen hakkatuv medabber ella besachir vechi illu lo secharo mi hittir lo sheyyavo becherem reehu bakkama shello shello middato ella kach hu omer ki tavo lirshut bealim laavoda tochal: 
Ma ben haose betalush leose bimchubbar. shehaose betalush ochel baddavar ad shello nigmar melachto umishshettiggamer melachto asur lo leechol. vehaose bimchubbar kegon botzer vekotzer eno ochel ella kesheyyigmor avodato kegon sheyyivtzor veyitten bassal ad sheyyemalleennu vinappetz hassal lemakom acher veyachzor veyivtzor vimalleennu veeno ochel ella ad achar sheyyemalle hassal. aval mippene heshshev aveda labbealim amru chachamim sheyyihyu happoalin ochlin bahalichatan meomen leomen uvachaziratan min haggat kede shello yibbatlu mimmelachtan veyeshvu leechol ella ochlin betoch hammelacha keshehen mehallechin veenan mevattelin: 
Hamevattel mimmelachto veachal o sheachal shello bishat gemar melacha hare ze over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 26)</small> "vechermesh lo tanif" vegomer. mippi hashshemua lamdu shekkol zeman shehu osek biktzira lo yanif chermesh laachilato. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen poel sheholich beyado mimma sheasa o shellakach yeter al achilato venoten laacherim over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 25)</small> "veel kelyecha lo titten". veen lokin al shene lavin ellu sheim achal o holich chayyav leshallem: 
Hacholev vehamechabbetz vehamegabben eno ochel mippene sheenan giddule karka. hamenakkesh bivtzalim uveshumin af al pi shettolshin ketannim mibben haggedolim vechol kayyotze baze eno ochel mippene sheen maasehem gemar melacha. veen tzarich lomar shomre ginnot ufardesim vechol davar hamechubbar kammikshaot vehammidlaot sheen ochlin kelal: 
Habbodel bitmarim uvigrogarot eno ochel mippene shennigmera melachtan lemaaser. haose bechittim vechayyotze bahen achar sheasu kegon shessecharan lavur tzerorot o lenappeach otan o litchon hare ellu ochlin sheadayin lo nigmera melachtan lechalla. aval hallash vehamekattef vehaofe eno ochel mippene shennigmera melachtan lechalla veen happoel ochel ella middavar sheadayin lo nigmera melachto lechalla ulemaaser: 
Nitparsu iggulav venitpattechu chaviyyotav [venechtechu deluav] usecharan laasot bahen hare ellu lo yochlu shehare nigmeru melachtan venikbeu lemaaser vahare hen tevel. veim lo hodian measser umaachilan. en happoalim ochlin beshel hekdesh shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 25)</small> "becherem reecha": 
Sachar poalin laasot beneta revai shello hare ellu lo yochlu. veim lo hodiam pode umaachilan: 
Hakkotzer vehaddash vehazzore vehabborer vehammosek vehabbotzer vehaddorech vechol kayyotze bimlachot ellu hare hem ochlin min hattora: 
Shomre gittot vaaremot vechol davar hattalush min hakkarka sheadayin lo nigmera melachtan lemaaser ochlin mehilchot medina shehashshomer eno keose maase. aval im asa beevarav ben beyadav ben beraglav afillu bichtefav hare ze ochel min hattora: 
Haya ose bitenim lo yochal baanavim baanavim lo yochal bitenim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 25)</small> "becherem" "veachalta anavim". vehaose begefen zo eno ochel begefen acheret. velo yochal anavim vedavar acher. velo yochal befat velo bemelach veim katzatz al baal habbayit al shiur ma sheyyochal ochel oto ben bemelach ben befat ben bechol davar sheyyirtze. asur lefoel lamotz baanavim shenneemar veachalta anavim. velo yihyu banav o ishto mehavehavin lo hashshibbolin baur shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 25)</small> "veachalta anavim kenafshecha" anavim kemot shehen. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Asur lappoel leechol mimma shehu ochel achila gassa shenneemar kenafshecha savecha. umuttar lo limnoa et atzmo ad mekom hayyafot veochel. veyesh lo leechol kishut afillu bedinar vechotevet afillu bedinar af al pi shessecharo bemaa kesef shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 25)</small> "kenafshecha savecha". aval melammedin et haadam shello yihye reavtan veyihye sotem et happetach befanav. haya meshammer arba o chamesh aremot lo yemalle kereso meachat mehen ella ochel mikkol achat veachat lefi cheshbon: 
Happoalim shello halchu sheti vaerev baggat ochlin anavim veen shotin yayin sheadayin enan osin ella baanavim bilvad. umishsheyyidrechu baggat vihallechu bah sheti vaerev yesh lahen leechol min haanavim velishtot min hattirosh shehare hen osin baanavim uvayyayin: 
Poel sheamar tenu leishti uvanay ma sheani ochel o sheamar hareni noten meat mizze shennatalti leechol leishti uvanay en shomin lo shello zikketa tora ella lappoel atzmo. afillu nazir shehaya ose baanavim veamar tenu leishti uvanay en shomin lo: 
Poel shehaya ose hu veishto uvanav vaavadav vehitna im habbaal habbayit shello yochlu mimma shehen osin lo hu velo hem hare ellu enan ochlin. bamme devarim amurim bigdolim mippene sheyyesh bahem daat vahare machalu aval ketannim eno yachol lifsok alehem shello yochlu sheenan ochlin mishshel avihen o mishshel adonehem ella mishshel shamayim:
Mishneh Torah, Hiring 13: Habbehema ochelet kol zeman shehi osa begiddule karka ben bimchubbar ben betalush. veochelet mimmassooy sheal gabbah ad shettihye poreket uvilvad shello yittol beyado veyaachilenna:

Kol hammonea habbehema milleechol bishat melachtah loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 4)</small> "lo tachsom shor bedisho". echad shor veechad kol mine behema vechayya ben temein ben tehorin veechad haddisha veechad kol shear hammelachot shel giddule karka velo neemar shor bedisho ella bahove. vehachosem et happoel patur. echad hachosem otah bishat melacha veechad hachosem otah mikkodem veasa bah melacha vehi chasuma afillu chasamah bekol loke. sachar behema vachasamah vedash bah loke umeshallem labbealim arbaat kabbin lefara usheloshet kabbin lachamor shemmishsheat meshicha nitchayyev bimzonoteha. veeno chayyav malkot ad sheyyadush bah chasuma:

Yisrael haddash befarato shel akkum over mishshum bal <small>(Devarim 25 4)</small> "tachsom". vehaakkum haddash befarato shel yisrael eno over mishshum bal tachsom. amar leakkum chasom parati vedush bah. yashav lah kotz befiha vedash bah vahare enah ochelet. hirbitz lah ari mibbachutz o shehirbitz benah mibbachutz. hare shetztzama veeno mashke otah. paras or al gabbe haddayish kede shello tochal. kol ze vechayyotze bo asur veeno loke. haya haddavar shehi osa bo ra livne meeha umazzikah o shehayta chola veim tochal mizze matrezet muttar lemanah. shello hikpida tora ella al hanaatah vahare enah nehenet:

Para shel yisrael shehaya kohen dash bah bitruma uvitrumat maaser shel vadday. vechen parot haddashot bemaaser sheni. ufarot hamehallechot al hattevua. lefi sheyyarat lahen hadderech eno over alehen mishshum bal <small>(Devarim 25 4)</small> "tachsom". aval mippene marit haayin im hayu dashot bitruma umaaser sheni mevi meat meoto hammin vetole lahen bakkerustelin shebbefihen:
Haddash bemaaser sheni shel demay uvitrumat maaser shel demay uvegiddule teruma over mishshum bal <small>(Devarim 25 4)</small> "tachsom":

Rashshay baal happara lehareiv parato ulesaggefah kede shettochal harebe min haddayish. verashshay hassocher lehaachilah pekie amir kede shello tochal harebe min haddayish. kayyotze bo rashshay baal habbayit lehashekot poalim yayin kede shello yochlu anavim harebe. verashshain poalin litbol pittan betzir kede sheyyochlu anavim harebe. aval en happoel rashshay laasot melachto ballayla ulehaskir atzmo bayyom o ladush befarato arvit ulehaskirah shacharit. velo yihye mariv umesaggef atzmo umaachil mezonotav levanav mippene gezel melachto shel baal habbayit. shehare tashesh kocho vetechalesh dato velo yaase melacha bechoach:

Kederech shemmuzhar baal habbayit shello yigzol sechar ani velo yeakkevennu kach heani muzhar shello yigzol melechet baal habbayit veyibbatel meat bechan umeat bechan umotzi kol hayyom bemirma ella chayyav ledakdek al atzmo bazzeman shehare hikpidu al beracha reviit shel birkat hammazon shello yevarech otah. vechen chayyav laavod bechol kocho shehare yaakov hatztzaddik amar <small>(Bereshit lo 6)</small> "ki bechol kochi avadti et avichen". lefichach natal sechar zot af baolam hazze shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 30 43)</small> "vayyifrotz haish meod meod": seliku lehu hilchot sechirut
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 1:
Deot harebe yesh lechol echad veechad mibbene adam vezo meshunna mizzo urechoka mimmennah beyoter. yesh adam shehu baal chema koes tamid. veyesh adam sheddato meyushshevet alav veeno koes kelal veim yichas yichas kaas meat bechamma shanim. veyesh adam shehu geva lev beyoter. veyesh shehu shefal ruach beyoter. veyesh shehu baal taava lo tisba nafsho mehaloch betaava. veyesh shehu baal lev tahor meod velo yitavve afillu lidvarim meattim shehagguf tzarich lahen. veyesh baal nefesh rechava shello tisba nafsho mikkol mamon haolam, kainyan shenneemar <small>(Kohelet 5 9)</small> "ohev kesef lo yisba kesef". veyesh mekatztzer nafsho sheddayyo afillu davar meat shello yaspik lo velo yirdof lehassig kol tzarko. veyesh shehu mesaggef atzmo beraav vekovetz al yado veeno ochel peruta mishshello ella betzaar gadol. veyesh shehu meabbed kol mamono beyado ledato. veal derachim ellu shear kol haddeot kegon meholel veonen vechilay veshoa veachzari verachaman verach levav veammitz lev vechayyotze bahen:
Veyesh ben kol dea vedea harchoka mimmenna bakkatze haacher deot benoniyyot zo rechoka mizzo. vechol haddeot yesh mehen deot shehen laadam mittechillat beriyyato lefi teva gufo. veyesh mehen deot shettivo shel adam ze mechuvvan veatid lekabbel otam bimhera yoter mishshear haddeot. veyesh mehen sheenan laadam mittechillat beriyyato ella lamad otam meacherim o shennifna lahen meatzmo lefi machashava shealta belibbo. o sheshshama shezzo haddea tova lo uvah rauy lelech vehinhig atzmo bah ad shennikbea belibbo:
Shete ketzavot harchokot zo mizzo shebbechol dea vedea enan derech tova veen rauy lo laadam lalechet bahen velo lelammedan leatzmo. veim matza tivo note leachat mehen o muchan leachat mehen o shekkevar lamed achat mehen venahag bah yachazir atzmo lammutav veyelech bederech hattovim vehi hadderech hayeshara:
Hadderech hayeshara hi midda benonit shebbechol dea vedea mikkol haddeot sheyyesh lo laadam. vehi haddea shehi rechoka mishshete hakketzavot richuk shave veenah kerova lo lazo velo lazo. lefichach tziuu chachamim harishonim sheyyehe adam sham deotav tamid umeshaer otam umechavvin otam badderech haemtzait kede sheyyehe shalem begufo. ketzad. lo yehe baal chema noach lichos velo kemet sheeno margish ella benoni. lo yichos ella al davar gadol sherauy lichos alav kede shello yease kayyotze bo paam acheret. vechen lo yitavve ella lidvarim shehagguf tzarich lahen vei efshar lihyot bezulatan kainyan shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 13 25)</small> "tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho". vechen lo yihye amel beisko ella lehassig davar shetztzarich lo lechayye shaa kainyan shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 37 16)</small> "tov meat latztzaddik". velo yikpotz yado beyoter. velo yefazzer mamono ella noten tzedaka kefi missat yado umalve karauy lemi shetztzarich. velo yehe meholel vesochek velo atzev veonen ella sameach kol yamav benachat besever panim yafot. vechen shear deotav. vederech zo hi derech hachachamim. kol adam sheddeotav deot (benonit) [benoniyyot] memutztzaot nikra chacham:
Umi shehu medakdek al atzmo beyoter veyitrachek middea benonit meat letzad ze o letzad ze nikra chasid. ketzad. mi sheyyitrachek miggova hallev ad hakkatze haacharon veyihye shefal ruach beyoter nikra chasid vezo hi middat chasidut. veim nitrachek ad haemtza bilvad veyihye anav nikra chacham vezo hi middat chachma. veal derech zo shear kol haddeot. vachasidim harishonim hayu mattin deot shellahen midderech haemtzait keneged shete hakketzavot. yesh dea shemmattin otah keneged hakkatze haacharon veyesh dea shemmattin otah keneged hakkatze harishon. vezehu lifnim mishshurat haddin. umetzuvvin anu lalechet badderachim haellu habbenonim vehem hadderachim hattovim vehayesharim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 28 9)</small> "vehalachta bidrachav":
Kach lamdu beferush mitzva zo. ma hu nikra channun af atta heye channun. ma hu nikra rachum af atta heye rachum. ma hu nikra kadosh af atta heye kadosh. veal derech zo karu hanneviim lael bechol otan hakkinnuyin erech appayim verav chesed tzaddik veyashar tamim gibbor vechazak vechayyotze bahen. lehodia shehen derachim tovim visharim vechayyav adam lehanehig atzmo bahen ulehiddammot elav kefi kocho:
Vechetzad yargil adam atzmo bedeot ellu ad sheyyikkavu bo. yaase veyishne vishallesh bammaasim sheose al pi haddeot haemtzaiyyot veyachazor bahem tamid ad sheyyihyu maasehem kallim alav velo yihye bahem torach alav veyikkavu haddeot benafsho. ulefi shehashshemot haellu nikra bahen hayyotzer vehem hadderech habbenonit sheanu chayyavin lalechet bah. nikret derech zo derech Adonai. vehi shellimmed avraham avinu levanav shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 18 19)</small> "ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzavve" vegomer. vehaholech bederech zo mevi tova uveracha leatzmo shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 18 19)</small> "lemaan havi Adonai al avraham et asher dibber alav":
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 2:
Chole hagguf toamim hammar matok umatok mar. veyesh min hacholim mi shemmitavve vetaev lemaachalot sheenan reuyin laachila kegon heafar vehappecham vesone hammaachalot hattovim kegon happat vehabbasar hakkol lefi rov hacholi. kach bene adam shennafshotehem cholot mitavvim veohavim haddeot haraot vesonim hadderech hattova umitatztzelim lalechet bah vehi keveda alehem limod lefi chalyam. vechen yeshayahu omer baanashim hallalu <small>(yeshaya 5 20)</small> "hoy haomrim lara tov velattov ra samim choshech leor veor lechoshech samim mar lematok umatok lemar". vaalehem neemar <small>(Mishlei 2 13)</small> "haozvim archot ysher lalechet bedarche chshech". uma hi takkanat chole hannefashot. yelchu etzel hachachamim shehen rofe hannefashot virappeu chalyam baddeot shemmelammedin otam ad sheyyachazirum ladderech hattova. vehammakkirim baddeot haraot shellahem veenam holchim etzel hachachamim lerappe otam alehem amar shelomo <small>(Mishlei 1 7)</small> "chachma umusar evilim bazu":
Vechetzad hi refuatam. mi shehu baal chema omrim lo lehanehig atzmo sheim hukka vekullal lo yargish kelal. veyelech bederech zo zeman merubbe ad sheyyitakker hachema millibbo. veim haya geva lev yanhig atzmo bevizzayon harebe veyeshev lematta min hakkol veyilbash beloye sechavot hamevazzot et lovshehem vechayyotze bidvarim ellu ad sheyyaakor gova hallev mimmennu veyachazor ladderech haemtzait shehu derech hattova. velichsheyyachazor ladderech haemtzait yelech bah kol yamav. veal kav ze yaase bishar kol haddeot im haya rachok lakkatze haechad yarchik atzmo lakkatze hashsheni veyinhog bo zeman rav ad sheyyachazor bo ladderech hattova vehi midda benonit shebbechol dea vedea:
Veyesh deot sheasur lo laadam linhog bahen bevenonit ella yitrachek min hakkatze haechad ad hakkatze haacher. vehu gova lev. sheen derech hattova sheyyihye adam anav bilvad ella sheyyihye shefal ruach vetihye rucho nemucha limod. ulefichach neemar bemoshe rabbenu <small>(Bamidbar 12 3)</small> "anav meod" velo neemar anav bilvad. ulefichach tziuu chachamim meod meod heve shefal ruach. veod amru shekkol hammagbiah libbo kafar baikkar shenneemar <small>(Devarim 8 14)</small> "veram levavecha veshachachta et Adonai elokecha". veod amru beshammata man deit beh gassut haruach vaafillu miktzatah. vechen hakkaas midda raa hi ad limod verauy laadam sheyyitrachek mimmenna ad hakkatze haacher. vilammed atzmo shello yichos vaafillu al davar sherauy lichos alav. veim ratza lehattil ema al banav uvene beto o al hatztzibbur im haya parnas veratza lichos alehen kede sheyyachzeru lammutav yare atzmo bifnehem shehu koes kede leyasseram vetihye dato meyushshevet beno leven atzmo keadam shehu medamme koes bishat kaaso vehu eno koes. amru chachamim harishonim kol hakkoes keillu oved avodat kochavim. veamru shekkol hakkoes im chacham hu chachmato mistalleket mimmennu veim navi hu nevuato mistalleket mimmennu. uvaale kaas en chayyehem chayyim. lefichach tziuu lehitrachek min hakkaas ad sheyyanhig atzmo shello yargish afillu laddevarim hammachisim vezo hi hadderech hattova. vederech hatztzaddikim hen aluvin veenan olvin shomim cherpatam veenam meshivin osin meahava usemechim beyissurim. vaalehem hakkatuv omer <small>(Shoftim 5 lo)</small> "veohavav ketzet hashshemesh bigvurato": 
Leolam yarbe adam bishtika velo yedabber ella o bidvar chachma o bidvarim shetztzarich lahem lechayye gufo. amru al rav talmid rabbenu hakkadosh shello sach sicha betela kol yamav. vezo hi sichat rov kol adam. vaafillu betzarche hagguf lo yarbe adam devarim. veal ze tziuu chachamim veamru kol hammarbe devarim mevi chet. veamru <small>(mishna avot 1 17)</small> "lo matzati lagguf tov ella shetika". vechen bedivre tora uvedivre chachma yihyu divre haadam meattim veinyenehem merubbim. vehu shetztziuu chachamim veamru <small>(gemara fesachim 3 2)</small> "leolam yishne adam letalmidav derech ketzara". aval im hayu haddevarim merubbin vehainyan muat hare zo sichlut veal ze neemar <small>(Kohelet 5 2)</small> "ki ba hachalom berov inyan vekol kesil berov devarim":
<small>(Mishna avot 3 13)</small> "seyag lachachma shetika". lefichach lo yemaher lehashiv velo yarbe ledabber. vilammed lattalmidim beshuva vanachat belo tzeaka uvelo arichut lashon. hu sheamar shelomo <small>(Kohelet 9 17)</small> "divre chachamim benachat nishmaim":
Asur laadam lehanehig atzmo bedivre chalakot ufittuy. velo yihye echad bappe veechad ballev ella tocho kevaro vehainyan shebballev hu haddavar shebbappe. veasur lignov daat habberiyyot vaafillu daat hannachri. ketzad. lo yimkor lenachri besar nevela bimkom besar shechuta. velo minal shel meta bimkom minal shel shechuta. velo yesarhev bachavero sheyyochal etzlo vehu yodea sheeno ochel. velo yarbe lo betikrovet vehu yodea sheeno mekabbel. velo yiftach lo chaviyyot shehu tzarich lefatchan lemachran kede lefattoto shebbishvil kevodo patach vechen kol kayyotze bo. vaafillu milla achat shel pittuy veshel genevat daat asur, ella sefat emet veruach nachon velev tahor mikkol amal vehauot:
Lo yehe adam baal sechok umahatallot velo atzev veonen ella sameach. kach amru chachamim sechok vekallut rosh margilin et haadam leerva. vetziuu shello yehe adam parutz bitzchok velo atzev umitabbel ella mekabbel et kol haadam besever panim yafot. vechen lo yihye baal nefesh rechava nivhal lahon velo atzev uvatel mimmelacha. ella baal ayin tova memaet beesek veosek battora. veoto hammeat shehu chelko yismach bo. velo baal ketata velo baal kina velo baal taava velo rodef achar hakkavod. kach amru chachamim hakkina vehattaava vehakkavod motziin et haadam min haolam. kelalo shel davar yelech bammidda habbenonit shebbechol dea vedea ad sheyyihyu kol deotav mechuvvanot baemtzaut. vehu sheshshelomo amar <small>(Mishlei 4 26)</small> "palles magal raglecha vechol derachecha yikkonu":
